title: Store Update 1.47.0
author: Embark | Raz
contents:
[p]Hey there, Raiders! 

Update 1.47.0 is underway, bringing two new color variants for the Riposta Set, an update on Fair Play & a few more fixes & improvements. A download is required, so make sure you do that before loading back in. [/p][h2]Highlights:
[/h2][list][*][p]Frozen Trail - First Look coming September 23rd![/p][/*][*][p]New Camo & White variants for the Riposta Set[/p][/*][*][p]An update on our ongoing Fair Play efforts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for the Rawhide Outfit, Keyboard Input issues and the occasional invisible door[/p][/*][*][p]Expedition 5 Sign-Up Reminder [/p][/*][/list][h2]Frozen Trail is coming - tune in for a First Look!
[/h2][p][u][url="https://x.com/ARCRaidersGame/status/2100978160364146717"]In case you missed it[/url][/u], we’ll be holding a First Look at Frozen Trail and what’s coming with the update [i]tomorrow![/i] On [b]September 23rd, at 10am PDT (7pm CEST)[/b], tune in for an extended peek at our biggest update yet.

Can’t wait to hear what you think! We’ve got more planned ahead of October 8th, stay tuned.
[/p][h2]Content and Bug Fixes 
[/h2][h3]Cosmetic[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Rawhide outfit’s headgear would remain on when toggled off in Customization.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Door blockers will no longer create a copy of their mesh on the opposite side from the direction they are applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where keyboard input could stop working after launching unfocused or returning from background, ensuring keyboard controls reliably respond when refocusing the window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where doors could become out of sync in some cases, making them appear open to the player whilst actually being closed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where swapping or splitting items could place them into incompatible containers (such as forcing non-quick-use items into the belt), and added safeguards against invalid inventory slot indexing in the inventory.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Maps
[/h3][p][b]Buried City[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where lighting in Buried City could appear overly dark or missing, improving overall visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Riven Tides[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed visual issues that could appear while traversing Riven Tides.[/p][/*][/list][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where objects in the world displayed incorrect colors, restoring items like red lockers, toolboxes, office chairs, cars, chests, and shipping containers to their intended appearance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where item tooltips in the inventory could keep data from previous screens, increasing memory use over time and affecting stability after long play sessions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Stability[/h3][list][*][p]Improved crash detection & diagnostics tools.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash that could occur during server shutdown, improving overall stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an Xbox issue that could cause resource conflicts.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]PS5[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed a frequent crash on PS5 related to the physics engine.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Inventory[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved stability when opening the Inventory screen.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][p][b]Expedition[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Expedition Project button now indicates when an Expedition is paused after the cutoff date and prevents committing resources.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Skill Tree[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed Skill Point assignment to hold-to-assign by default in the Skill Tree.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]A Quick Update on Fair Play Efforts
[/h2][p]While our dev team is hard at work putting the finishing touches on Frozen Trail, our Anti-Cheat team is making constant updates and improvements across the board to our Fair Play initiatives.
[/p][p]When it comes to economy-related manipulation, there have been several ban waves for accounts we detected exhibiting "bot-like" behavior. We’ll continue to track and refine our detection to cover broader types of suspect behavior (such as XP farming) in the future, as well. We also continue sanctioning abnormally high-value item transfers. Item duplication is also on our minds, and we’re seeing positive outcomes following this summer’s ongoing improvements on that front.
[/p][p]We are constantly working on ways to prevent serial cheaters and discourage them from returning. Currently, we're strengthening our policies when it comes to shared licenses and how those are restricted when an account is sanctioned. In practice, this will make it harder for cheaters who were detected on one account to purchase another. Keeping track of a cheater's behavior before and after receiving a sanction helps us anticipate it and act faster in the future.
[/p][p]Previously, we mentioned the speed of action against unfair play is important to us. To that end, we have been improving our detection systems and we are extending first-strike permanent bans. This allows us to catch offenders much quicker with a very high degree of confidence.
[/p][p]While we keep improving and expanding the ways we keep Topside fair, we want to thank you for helping us do that by reporting players and sharing any illicit behavior with us.
[/p][h2]Reminder - Claim your Rubber Ducks![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/1c3f677b1f4d5e473d6f8cfa792c0075257919d4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Heads up! After [b]October 8th[/b], the inbox message that contains the community-made Rubber Ducks will no longer be sent out. [b]Make sure to log in and claim them before that deadline. [/b]

Wouldn’t wanna miss out on those awesome ducks!
[/p][h2]Expedition 5 - Departure Window closes September 29th
[/h2][p]Make sure to finish up your Expedition project [i]and[/i] sign up for Departure before September 29th 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT. 

There is [b]no Last Call[/b] this time around, so be mindful of that!
[/p][p]We know that a few of you are having issues with the Departure screen. If you are experiencing issues confirming your sign-up for departure, please reach out to support as soon as possible. You can do so [url="https://id.embark.games/id/sign-in"][u]here[/u][/url].
[/p][h2]Known Issues
[/h2][list][*][p]We are deploying multiple stability improvements targeting Xbox Series X|S crashes. Please report any persistent issues to help guide further fixes. [/p][/*][*][p]There are future improvements in the works for the Quick Wheel’s behavior to prevent inaccurate switching or “jumping” from one item slot to the other.[/p][/*][*][p]The weapon swap animation may appear broken if weapon swapping right after vaulting.[/p][/*][*][p]Player animations may appear broken when interrupting a search of the Baron Husk.[/p][/*][*][p]Shredders float to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Leapers can jump through the ARC Turbine.[/p][/*][*][p]Shots taken while riding ARC may not register correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The player's character may stutter / jitter after being revived.[/p][/*][*][p]The Matriarch may occasionally not use all of its ranged attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]The player's footsteps are inaudible during constant shoulder swap while sprinting.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can sometimes get stuck on obstacles while sliding downhill.[/p][/*][*][p]When using keyboard layouts other than US English, custom keybindings reset after every raid.[/p][/*][*][p]In some instances, long lists of text can disappear when scrolling through them.[/p][/*][/list][p]
See you soon!
//Raz[/p]

title: Live Update 1.45.0
author: embark_ossen
contents:
[p]Raiders![/p][p][/p][p]Update 1.45.0 is going live right now and with it a number of fixes, a new Raider Project, the start of the fifth Expedition, the Hornet Hunter Set and changes coming to Cred. Make sure to restart the game to get the download.[/p][p]This will be our last Live Update before October 8, but we won't be going quiet in the meantime, a smaller update is still planned before then!
[/p][h2][b]HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Raider Project: Ascending the Mountain[/p][/*][*][p]The Hornet Hunter Set[/p][/*][*][p]Cred Expiration[/p][/*][*][p]Expedition 5[/p][/*][*][p]Community Rubber Ducks[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Forging the Way North[/b][/h2][p]Raider efforts have revealed clues to the mystery of phantom ARC signals that have Shani concerned. Unfortunately, these signals lead ARC to a place we can’t follow -  the mountain range just beyond the reach of our Tube system. Rumor has it Apollo’s working on an experimental solution, and he’s requested assistance from Raiders who understand schematics, and can keep their heads down.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/334f29118412049c39bd33558da3ccdc71df7dce.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Cred Expiration[/b][/h2][p]As we look ahead to Frozen Trail and a rework to Raider Decks, we’ll be making changes to the Cred currency. It will remain usable until October 8, so be sure to use any remaining Cred before then.  [/p][p]We are retiring Cred as a currency, as we’ll be introducing a more expansive reward system launching with the Frozen Trail Update. All existing Raider Deck rewards will also be available in the new system. You will keep any rewards you have already claimed at the time of the update. [/p][p]Any Cred remaining on your account will expire with the Frozen Trail update, so please be sure to spend your Cred with Shani or on any remaining Raider Deck rewards.
 [/p][h2][b]Community Rubber Ducks[/b][/h2][p]The community designed duckies that you have selected have finally made their way into the game! Head on over to Bird City and display them proudly in your Raider Den! [/p][p]Again, huge congratulations to the designers: [i]gekko.rar, im_AshCheeks and nassguhl![/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/2ecf91b33a3bff35e7f656cce35c7c525a317afd.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content and Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3]ARC[/h3][list][*][p]Snitch Scanners will now spawn ARC similarly to the regular Snitch, but with a lower chance for stronger ARC.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Equalizer could play its firing sound effect when holstering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where voice chat did not work when Raider Voice was enabled. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Customization[/h3][list][*][p]The Boonie outfit will be available from September 15th.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay [/h3][list][*][p]Landing on moving surfaces will now make you follow that surface when landing, not while still in the air.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now rebind quick item cycling separately from the quick-use wheel (or disable cycling), and you may bind both to the same key. This helps prevent unintended item swaps after closing the wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ARC Turbine mines could not be pinged.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced weapon sway for Aphelion to improve aiming stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting an Expedition no longer resets your quests by default; you can now choose whether to reset them when departing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Matriarch’s stomp could damage players through tall cover or when standing on top of the Matriarch.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Stability [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash on PS5 that could occur shortly after starting a session.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when rapidly pressing certain keys during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where a squad could become stuck after a squadmate signed out and rejoined, blocking ready-up and preventing matchmaking from starting. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Upgraded Unreal Engine from 5.3 to 5.7.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]The UI indicator showing the current weight of your loadout is now updated directly when dropping parts of a stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual tweaks to selected nodes in the Skill Tree.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some distance based map markers didn't appear correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The pick up prompt will now show “loadout full” while trying to pick up an item with a full inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved matchmaking error messaging: you’ll now see clearer explanations if you go offline while queuing or if your crossplay settings are incompatible, helping diagnose failed matchmaking attempts.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/5585508ec3eb4b1065ec8b36e8f364c61936e2bb.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The second part of the Phantom Targets project could not be started for some players. We will be sending out compensation in a future update.[/p][/*][*][p]There are multiple stability improvements targeting Xbox Series S crashes. Please report any persistent issues to help guide further fixes. [/p][/*][*][p]We’re aware of issues with crashing on PC, related to Windows Update KB5121003. Please consult our [url="https://discord.com/channels/1107589599045361695/1107613897357275188/1537853764193624105"][u]workaround shared here[/u][/url] while we work on a fix.[/p][/*][*][p]Players on Epic may experience a sudden loss of keyboard input.[/p][list][*][p]While we look into this, we recommend disabling any Overlay you may have active. Additionally, you can try alt-tabbing out and back into the game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Rawhide headgear stays on with the toggle set to off.
The throw animation may sometimes fail to play when attempting to detonate a Trigger ‘Nade immediately after throwing it.[/p][/*][*][p]The weapon swap animation may appear broken if weapon swapping right after vaulting.[/p][/*][*][p]Player animations may appear broken when interrupting a search of the Baron Husk.[/p][/*][*][p]Shredders float to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Leapers can jump through the ARC Turbine.[/p][/*][*][p]Shots taken while riding ARC may not register correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Some doors may allow player flashlights’ beams to pass through instead of blocking the emitted light.[/p][/*][*][p]We are aware of some clipping issues with the Triumph, Reaver and Azimuth outfits.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you Topside,[/p][p]//Ossen[/p]

contents:
[p align="start"]It’s Tuesday, Raiders![/p][p align="start"]Store Update 1.43.0 is rolling out now, introducing the heavy duty Roamer Set! Make sure to restart your game to get the latest version.[/p][p][/p][h3]Phantom Targets Event - Earn the Anomalia Outfit[/h3][p align="start"]Shani’s investigation into the strange ARC behavior is ongoing…[/p][p align="start"]The Phantom Targets Event is live till [b]September 06[/b], get out there and hunt down those erratic Wasps for their strange glitched tech.[/p][p align="start"]Knowledge is key to survival, we need to find out what they’re doing, and fast.
You’ll earn the Anomalia Outfit for your contribution to the research effort, alongside the Finger Guns Wave emote, Trashpile Bag, and Raider Tokens to get you appropriately dripped up for what’s on the horizon…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/faa176ea9ea099d2b986abbc1526fd73a5471758.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Anti-Cheat & Linked Accounts[/b][/h3][p]As we continue ramping up on our anti-cheat efforts, we are doubling down on linked accounts. If someone gets access to your account, either with your permission or not, and they're caught cheating, your account can be banned even though you weren't the one cheating.
[/p][p]In order to make sure this does not happen, now is a good time to make sure your account is properly secured via your login provider (Steam, Sony, Xbox, Epic, etc.):[/p][list][*][p]Use a strong, unique password[/p][/*][*][p]Enable two-factor authentication[/p][/*][*][p]Never share your login details with anyone[/p][/*][/list][p]Keeping your account secure helps protect your progress and keeps the game fair for everyone. We’re loading the shuttles with merch and coaxing Scrappy into his travel carrier as we write this. Swing by the booth to say hi and scavenge some freebies![/p][p align="start"]See you at the booth or online![/p]

title: The 5th Expedition
author: embark_ossen
contents:
[p]The fifth Expedition window is fast approaching, and with it come a few changes. Based on your feedback, in upcoming Expeditions you’ll be able to opt out of resetting your quest progress, the departure window will be extended by one week, and there won’t be the last call feature this time around.
Additionally, we will be pausing Expeditions for a short while to dig deeper into the core systems and make them feel more rewarding and fun!
[/p][h2][b]TIMING[/b][/h2][p]Expedition Window[b] opens on [/b]September 8, 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT, and closes September 29 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.[/p][p][/p][p]As with all previous Expeditions, completing your Caravan does not count as signing up for the Expedition, you still have to sign up during the window and this time around there is no ‘last call’ feature.
[/p][p]Expeditions are a personal progression that players complete in order. The Caravan can be completed in between Expedition windows but finishing the Expedition can only be done during the scheduled Expedition window.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]HOW TO DO THE EXPEDITION[/b][/h2][olist][*][p][b]Complete the Caravan[/b][/p][olist][*][p]The option to contribute to the Caravan starts as soon as you complete the previous Expedition and if this is your first Expedition, you can start contributing right away.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Wait for the Expedition Window[/b][/p][olist][*][p]The next window opens on September 8, 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT, and closes on September 29, 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Sign Up[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Once the Expedition window opens, you need to sign up.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Complete the Challenge[/b][/p][olist][*][p]In order to get the rewards, players will need to complete a challenge within the Expedition Window (more details below).[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Catch Up[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Catch up on missed skill points (max 5 per Expedition) for players on their second, third or fourth Expedition (more details below).[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Depart[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Everyone that signed up departs on September 29.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]No Last Call[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Make sure to sign up for departure during the window.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][h2][b]WHAT’S NEW[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Opt-in Quest reset[/b][/p][list][*][p]We have seen your feedback about the quest line feeling repetitive after every Expedition. To address this, we want to give you the option not to reset your quests and keep your progress so you can continue from where you left off. Since the Hullcracker Blueprint can only be obtained through the quest line, we will give you other ways to get it.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]No Last Call[/b][/p][list][*][p]Make sure to sign up during the departure window so you don’t miss out on the Expedition.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The expedition window is [b]extended[/b] from two to three weeks.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/5242e3fadf96177d9925de120c1ebef4fe2b8302.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]REWARDS[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The complete Zenith Outfit[/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/the-fourth-expedition#mystery-rewards"]Mystery Rewards[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p]+12 stash space, maxed out at 60[/p][/*][*][p]Skill points:[/p][list][*][p]The bonus skill points from Expeditions cap at 15. Players can still catch-up on previously missed skill points and it’s still tied to stash value. Catch-up for skill points becomes available with your second Expedition and once you get all the maximum 15 skill points, the catch-up is no longer available.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Consecutive buffs: [/p][list][*][p]The XP boost, Scrappy materials boost and repair value increase capped at three levels.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Trials[/b][/h2][p]The season currently ongoing will end on September 22, and after that Trials will be on pause for two weeks until October 8.
[/p][h2][b]FUTURE EXPEDITIONS[/b][/h2][p]We have been carefully reviewing your feedback on Expeditions, and while we've made ongoing improvements along the way, we've come to realize that some of the issues you've raised, like the tight departure windows, the reward structure, and accessibility for new players, need more than incremental fixes. They call for bigger changes.[/p][p][/p][p]In order to address those concerns, we need to pause the Expeditions for a while. The fifth Expedition will be the last one until early 2027, when Expeditions will return with major improvements, tackling some of the biggest player pain points. So, if you’ve been on the fence about departing - now is the time! We will share more details on what those changes will look like in September.[/p][p][/p][p]During the pause period, any of the consecutive buffs you have earned will persist so no progress is lost. If you have completed all five Expeditions, the Zenith Outfit will be fully unlocked. Also, since Caravans will be reset, any partially completed Caravans will be replaced with Ermal Vouchers of equal value which can be used to purchase Ermal offers together with ARC Parts and firearms trade, or sold for Coin.

As always, keep the feedback coming. Let us know what you think, and we will continue to make improvements.[/p][p]The ARC Raiders Team[/p]

title: Live Update 1.42.0
author: embark_ossen
contents:
[p]Raiders!
[/p][p]Update 1.42.0 is live right now and with it a number of fixes, a second part of the Phantom Targets event with the Anomalia Outfit, a new Player Project, improved map condition scheduling, and new Twitch drops. [/p][h2][b]HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Phantom Targets Event & Phantom Targets Part 2 Raider Project[/p][/*][*][p]The Tick Hunter Set is now available[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Regional Map Condition Schedule[/p][/*][*][p]An Update on Anti-Cheat and Fair Play[/p][/*][*][p]New [u][url="https://arcraiders.com/twitch-drops"]Twitch Drops[/url][/u] (Car Freshener & Ceramic Vase)[/p][/*][*][p]Rubber Duck Competition Winners
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Phantom Targets Revealed[/b][/h2][p]Thanks to the assistance of many Raiders, Shani finally pinpointed the source of the phantom targets: erratic Wasps. These ARC units are exhibiting behavior she’s never seen before: emitting strange noises, flying in irregular patterns, and carrying unidentifiable tech. They’re all swarming towards one location. She needs further assistance to understand what’s waiting for them there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/c375b8e1a5906cea27d9fba5750a6deb37c59403.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Improvements to Map Condition Scheduling [/b][/h2][p]We have been working to make sure that the way we schedule Map Conditions is aligned with your playing habits. To that end, we’re introducing [i]Regional Map Condition Scheduling[/i]. Starting with 1.42.0, Map Conditions will have their schedule offset based on regions, instead of a single, global schedule.
[/p][p]This means that the schedule will shift to fit specific regions' peak hours to better match your experience. This way, it’ll be less likely to miss out on a map condition regardless of where you are.
[/p][p]Don’t hesitate to tell us how Regional Map Condition schedules are working by chatting with us on our Discord! We’re eager to see what everyone’s experience is like and make adjustments accordingly.
[/p][p][i]Note: the [url="https://arcraiders.com/map-conditions"][u]Map Condition tracker[/u][/url] on the website now reflects this change.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Following up about Fair Play [/b][/h2][p]It’s time to look at what’s been going on in the realm of Fair Play since our last chat [u][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/live-update-1-36-0#maintaining-fair-play"]a few weeks back[/url][/u]. Some new (and some recurring) topics have crossed our path since then, and we wanted to reassure you that keeping Topside safe against cheaters and exploits is a top priority for us, and will continue to be so.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Note on Third Party Software[/b][/h3][p]When we see reports of third party software being used to gain an advantage of any kind, in-game or at account level, we investigate. The first and most important step is to verify the validity of the report and whether or not the software actually does what it claims to do. A lot of the time, claims are just that, and interacting with this kind of software carries a large amount of risk.
 
Be aware that downloading unverified and unofficial software can put more than just your account at risk. Beyond getting banned and losing access to the game, your data and personal information could be exposed.
[/p][p]Remember that your account is only as secure as its weakest link. In order to protect your account, your purchases and progression, we strongly recommend making sure 2FA or passkeys are enabled on all external accounts connected to your Embark ID. Oh, and never share your credentials with anyone. No matter how many ducks they offer.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Recent Actions & Future Plans[/b][/h3][p]Over the past few weeks, we have been making several improvements alongside Anybrain and Denuvo Anti-Cheat. This has resulted in swift action being taken against a large number of accounts that were using recently popularized cheating software.
[/p][p]There is also the matter of ensuring permanent sanctions for serial, blatant cheaters. We continue working on methods that make it more difficult for new accounts to be obtained and that discourage cheaters from returning.
[/p][p]There have been compounding improvements in our ability to also detect accounts that participated in what we classify as “economy exploits”, which means we can more quickly sanction offenders. These types of sanctions have been ongoing.
[/p][p]Additionally, we have several simultaneous initiatives that are meant to address teaming and general matchmaking abuse. We know how important having a consistently good experience is, and that in certain regions or at certain times, it’s easier to run into groups of players that try to force their way into lobbies and engage in griefing. We’ll share more when all of these are ready.
[/p][p]And that’s, of course, not all. We’ll keep building up all of the initiatives we mentioned and we’ll do our best to make sure that your experiences across the Rust Belt are fun, thrilling, and most importantly [i]fair[/i].[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Congratulations to the Winners of the Rubber Duck Design Contest![/b][/h3][p]Last Thursday, the 3 finalists of the Rubber Duck Design Contest were selected via popular vote on our [u][url="https://discord.gg/ekG4VTdg7R"]Discord[/url][/u]. We have since begun working on bringing the ducks into the game, and we will add them in a future update! 

Soon enough, you’ll be able to fill your Raider Den with ducks made by the super-talented [i]gekko.rar, im_AshCheeks and nassguhl.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/4629086dffeb64465cf8eb3679cc0087790124c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Content and Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Refined footstep and movement sounds indoors: removed scuff sounds, improved audibility at distance, and updated occlusion and concrete surface cues.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved footstep audio when moving through foliage for clearer, more natural sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique footstep sounds when moving over plastic cloth and tarp surfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Added different audio for all Tier 3 magazine upgrades firing sounds.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]The Snitch can now call in a Rocketeer. Additionally, it can also call in a Firefly and Hornet duo. Snitch Scanners should not be affected by this change.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stomp attacks from the Queen and Matriarch sometimes hitting through walls or from much farther away than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]The Photoelectric Cloak now works against Turbine lightning attacks and Matriarch missiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Added spawn protection to the Surge Coil Trap to avoid affecting players as they spawn in.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to rebind Quick Wheel slots.[/p][/*][*][p]The Dolabra, Hullcracker and Rascal now deal damage correctly in the Practice Range.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Map[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a zip line in Buried City couldn’t be interacted with by repositioning it to ensure it can be used.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Improved UI texture streaming cache for better memory efficiency and reliability.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Stability[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several crashes and made various improvements to stability.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed project tiles incorrectly showing “Part X completed” on projects without parts.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected spelling errors and updated localized text across multiple languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished matchmaking error messages for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Completed project quests now correctly bring you to the associated project page when pressing the “Claim” shortcut button in the logbook.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Region label on the Map selection screen, which displays your current Matchmaking region.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We’re continuing to investigate reports of crashes on XBOX Series S. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your reports. As soon as we know more, we’ll let you know. [/p][/*][*][p]We’re aware of issues with crashing on PC, related to Windows Update KB5121003. Please consult our [u][url="https://discord.com/channels/1107589599045361695/1107613897357275188/1537853764193624105"]workaround shared here[/url][/u] while we work on a fix.[/p][/*][*][p]Players on Epic may experience a sudden loss of keyboard input.[/p][list][*][p]While we look into this, we recommend disabling any Overlay you may have active. Additionally, you can try alt-tabbing out and back into the game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Projects tab has a sticky notification dot.[/p][/*][*][p]The throw animation may sometimes fail to play when attempting to detonate a Trigger ‘Nade immediately after throwing it.[/p][/*][*][p]The weapon swap animation may appear broken if weapon swapping right after vaulting.[/p][/*][*][p]Player animations may appear broken when interrupting a search of the Baron Husk.[/p][/*][*][p]Shredders float to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Leapers can jump through the ARC Turbine.[/p][/*][*][p]When bringing items that give Merits with you into a Raid, the items will wrongfully display a Merits icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Shots taken while riding ARC may not register correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Some doors may allow player flashlights’ beams to pass through instead of blocking the emitted light.[/p][/*][*][p]We are aware of some clipping issues with the Triumph, Reaver and Azimuth outfits.[/p][/*][*][p]Old Ermal offers may appear to be available in the 'Acquire and Craft' menu (visual only).

title: Live Update 1.39.0
author: Embark | Raz
contents:
[p]Greetings Raiders!

Live Update 1.39.0 is going out right now, bringing various game fixes, changes & additional updates to the Matchmaking System. The Seeker & Wolfpack should no longer deal inconsistent damage and trinkets previously added in 1.33.0 can now stack! Additionally, you can find the new [b]Dweller Outfit[/b] in the store.
[/p][h3][b]Matchmaking Update: Testing Defensive PvP[/b][/h3][p]Over the past months, improving matchmaking has been one of our top priorities. We’ve introduced various adjustments and improvements based on your feedback & requests.

Since our[url="https://arcraiders.com/news/notes-on-the-matchmaking-system"] [u]Notes on The Matchmaking System[/u][/url], one change has stood out with the community: [b]defending yourself is no longer treated the same as starting a fight.[/b] It meant self-defense still counted toward your playstyle estimate, but with much less weight than starting a fight. Your feedback was positive, and many of you have asked us to take it further.[/p][p]The most common follow-up request we've seen is to [b]remove the impact of Defensive PvP entirely[/b] - going from reduced weight to none at all. Starting now, we're testing exactly that. During the test, only the fights you choose to start will influence your playstyle estimate, and defending yourself won't affect it at all. This includes knocking out enemies who attacked you first.[/p][p]So what counts as starting a fight, and what counts as defending yourself? Here's how the system reads an encounter:[/p][list][*][p][b]Who's defending:[/b] If the other squad damages, downs, or knocks out any of your squadmates first, your whole squad counts as defending - the squad that strikes first is the one that started the fight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]How it's weighed:[/b] The more serious the encounter, the more it counts. A drawn-out firefight - with more damage dealt and raiders downed - weighs heavily, while a stray accidental hit or a brief exchange where the other squad flees after minimal damage still counts as starting a fight but weighs far less.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Third-partying:[/b] Jumping into a fight between other squads that's already underway counts as starting a fight, too.[/p][/*][/list][p]Over the coming weeks we'll monitor our matchmaking metrics, watch how PvP develops Topside, and gather your feedback.
[/p][h3][b]Matchmaking Changes: Follow-up[/b][/h3][p]Two earlier changes are also still live: the[url="https://arcraiders.com/news/live-update-1-36-0#solo-duo-and-trio-matchmaking"] [u]Solo, Duo, and Trio matchmaking[/u][/url] tracking from 1.36.0 and the[url="https://arcraiders.com/news/patch-notes-1-38-0#matchmaking-optimization"] [u]matchmaking optimization[/u][/url] adjustments from 1.38.0. We're keeping a close watch on how both perform, but telemetry only tells us half the story - to get the full picture, we need to hear how your matches actually feel. [/p][p]The latest [url="https://id.embark.games/id/arc-raiders/survey"][u]matchmaking survey[/u][/url] covers all of this, so take a minute to fill it out - your input is the other half, and it's what turns our data into better decisions. Thank you, Raiders!
[/p][h3][b]Reminder - ARC Raiders & THE FINALS Crossover [/b][/h3][p]Raiders & Contestants, don’t forget! You’ve got until July 30th at 3PM CEST to complete the required Contracts in THE FINALS and earn the Azimuth outfit & the Archaeologist Backpack bundle in ARC Raiders.[/p][p]Afterwards, we’re back to the Rust Belt! You’ll be able to earn the Azimuth bundle in THE FINALS by heading Topside and playing ARC Raiders.
[/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes & Content Updates[/b][/h2][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved footstep audio in water.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more distinct Dodge Roll sounds and variations.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted ambient audio for certain cinematics.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Cosmetics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed mislabeled customization toggles for the Blindspot Set. “No Headset” now controls the headset on Blindspot.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated customization toggles: The Triumph Set now uses Helmet Only; The Scorta Set now uses Gauntlet Off.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated Scorta outfit color names in the UI to better match the actual colors.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a missing UI string for a blue backpack cosmetic.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed inconsistent damage for Seeker Grenade and Wolfpack Grenade.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Train model could appear in two places in the Raider Den when only one was owned.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Trinkets introduced alongside the Converging Paths project now stack similarly to other trinkets, and their drops have been adjusted for more consistent looting across maps.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Map[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed multiple clipping issues, floating props, landscape holes, and spots where players could get stuck on Dam Battlegrounds.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed multiple collision and clipping issues on Buried City (including invisible obstacles), corrected materials, and resolved a spot where downed players could get stuck near an overpass.[/p][/*][*][p]Closed a hole in Buried City that allowed using the Snap Hook to go out of bounds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause players to get stuck in the End of Round tunnel after leaving a map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a startup crash that could occur after the photosensitive warning screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Polished UI text and updated localization across supported languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where item prices over 10,000 were shown with incorrect shorthand in the Trader tab when using Japanese or Simplified Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization for Trinket names and ARC terminology across menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the start screen with a new looping background video.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing L3 on gamepad wouldn’t toggle the item tooltip on Ermal’s Select Items screen, and added a background blur to improve readability.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated Projects list and screens to group related Projects for easier browsing.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Project UI: corrected text, improved previews for multi‑phase projects, and projects now unlock after playing 5 rounds. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with background visuals updating incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Projects could fail to advance to the next step after completing a goal, even after contributing the required items.[/p][/*][*][p]The Projects Tab has been improved with added quest & step descriptions, more consistent text and reward tiles and restored navigation so completed stages can be reviewed after finishing a project.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Trophy Display Raider Project rewards preview showed a duplicate "Howl" Emote.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Expedition and Project UI: grouped projects only appear when at least one is active, fixed top bar navigation, and corrected Expedition step display.[/p][/*][*][p]Standardized the timer display across Project and Expedition screens for clearer countdowns.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We are investigating an ongoing issue where some XBOX players (particularly on Series S) are experiencing crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Quick Wheel item selection may suddenly swap to another item on the Wheel when closing the Quick Wheel and re-opening it quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]The Dolabra, Hullcracker and Rascal do not deal damage to training dummies on Practice Range.[/p][/*][*][p]The throw animation may sometimes fail to play when attempting to detonate a Trigger ‘Nade immediately after throwing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Some gadgets and throwables lack a “Cancel” button when preparing to throw them.[/p][/*][*][p]The weapon swap animation may appear broken if weapon swapping right after vaulting.[/p][/*][*][p]Player animations may appear broken when interrupting a search of the Baron Husk.[/p][/*][*][p]Shredders float to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Leapers can jump through the ARC Turbine.[/p][/*][*][p]When picking up items, the pickup sound may not be the correct one.[/p][/*][*][p]When bringing items that give Merits with you into a Raid, the items will wrongfully display a Merits icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Shots taken while riding ARC may not register correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Some doors may allow player flashlights’ beams to pass through instead of blocking the emitted light.[/p][/*][*][p]Some hairstyles may clip through the Reaver Outfit helmet.[/p][/*][*][p]We are aware of some clipping issues with the Triumph and Azimuth outfits.[/p][/*][*][p]Old Ermal offers may appear to be available in the 'Acquire and Craft' menu (visual only).
[/p][/*][/list][p]See you Topside,[/p][p]//Raz[/p][p]and The ARC Raiders Team[/p][p]
[/p]

title: Live Update 1.36.0
author: embark_ossen
contents:
[p]Raiders!
[/p][p]Your tentative alliance with the Nomads is progressing by the day. Nomads wander the streets of Speranza, bringing stories, valuable information, and loot to trade. As the ARC presence Topside ever increases in scale, making reliable friends has never been so important. [/p][p][/p][p]The 1.36.0 update has just dropped, bringing bug fixes, QoL updates, matchmaking tweaks, new Expedition and Trials Season, and a crossover outfit from the virtual gameshow world of THE FINALS! [/p][h2][b]What’s New?[/b][/h2][list][*][p][u][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/the-fourth-expedition"]Expedition 4[/url][/u] - Zenith Outfit[/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/trials-season-5"]Trials Season 5[/url][/u] - Scorta Outfit[/p][/*][*][p]Solo, Duo, and Trio Matchmaking[/p][/*][*][p]ARC Raiders & THE FINALS Crossover[/p][/*][*][p]Store Update - The Triumph Set[/p][/*][*][p]Store Redesign[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Solo, Duo, and Trio Matchmaking[/b][/h3][p]Following your feedback on the Matchmaking survey published in May, we have implemented one of the most requested matchmaking features:[/p][p]
[b]We now track your playstyle separately for Solo, Duo, and Trio rounds, and match you accordingly.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Say you are a friendly solo player, but your two squadmates always want to dominate in trios PvP. Before, being friendly solo could push you into more cooperative trio rounds, and playing PvP-focused in a trio could push you into more PvP-focused solo rounds - so changing squad size meant matchmaking took a bit to adjust.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, there's no overlap. You'll be able to go from friendly questing and plant-picking in Solo rounds to adrenaline-fueled PvP Trio games (if that's how you usually play in those respective cases), by simply changing your squad size. The same holds for Duo - all three are tracked on their own.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]ARC Raiders & THE FINALS Crossover[/b][/h3][p]Complete a set of Contracts in THE FINALS and unlock the Azimuth outfit and Archeologist backpack bundle in ARC Raiders. [/p][h2][b]Maintaining Fair Play[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We know Topside can sometimes be dangerous and unpredictable (which is why we love it), but nobody’s a fan of Raiders finding ways to get unfair advantages.[/p][p][/p][p]Since our May update on [url="https://arcraiders.com/news/ensuring-fair-play"][u]Ensuring Fair Play[/u][/url], we’ve been striving to provide steady [url="https://arcraiders.com/news/live-update-1-33-0#anti-cheat"][u]updates[/u][/url] on how the fight against players who seek unfair advantages is going. Today, we’re taking a moment to recap everything we’ve been up to, and to provide some additional details.
[/p][h3]Anti-Cheat and Detection[/h3][p][/p][p]Over the past few weeks, we’ve completed our rollout of Denuvo Anti-Cheat. It is now enforced for all players, and the results we’ve seen so far have been promising. 
[/p][p]Thanks to the efforts of our anti-cheat team, we are continuously getting more effective at identifying & acting against cheaters. 
[/p][p]These improvements are the product of constant refinements to our anti-cheat stack (hardware & software detection, ML-driven input telemetry analysis and much, much more).
[/p][h3]Handling & Preventing Item Duplication[/h3][p][/p][p]Like with anti-cheat, we are always working against duplication exploits. We’re keeping a close eye on the game economy, and constantly catalogue, investigate and seek to counteract exploits.[/p][p][/p][p]Recently, we’ve fixed some exploits related to duplication. We always want to make sure fixes are widely effective, so we make sure to monitor and evaluate our success before sharing that progress with you. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/cdaa08925b0b999d878566d90ccfc8c81bf3cb6b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Evolving “No Free Loadouts”
[/h3][p]Sometimes, going into a high-value map condition and encountering raiders with free kits can also feel unfair. Since 1.33.0, we have introduced the experimental “No Free Loadout” requirement for Night Raid and Close Scrutiny. We’ve seen your reactions, and we’re taking your feedback into account.[/p][p][/p][p]We are looking into expanding “No Free Loadout” to more map conditions and investigating other opportunities to further improve the experience overall. We really appreciate the feedback you have been sharing in the survey from last week and we will keep you in the loop once we have new changes for you to try. [/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Next?[/h2][p][/p][p]There is yet more work to be done, of course. When we can, we want to share more of our progress on all of these initiatives. As you may have noticed, you now receive an in-game Action Notice when we’ve taken action against someone you reported. We’re also continuing to compensate for loot lost to cheaters, regardless of whether you reported them or not. 

These are separate parts of the same system. We will continue to provide progress updates when we can, and we’re thankful for your efforts in reporting and informing us about unlawful behavior.[/p][p][/p][p]See you Topside,[/p][p]//Ossen [/p][p]and The ARC Raiders Team[/p][p]

title: The Fourth Expedition
author: embark_ossen
contents:
[p]The fourth Expedition is almost here, and it’s bringing some exciting changes. Each Expedition we run, we learn something new and look for ways to make improvements. This time around, that means shaking things up with an updated reward structure.
[/p][p][b]Complete your fourth Expedition to earn the first level of the new Zenith Outfit. Prove yourself with the Expedition Challenge and instead of Skill Points, you’ll earn Blueprints to jumpstart your Topside adventures and Raider Tokens to keep you looking sharp every step of the way.[/b][/p][p] [/p][h2][b]TIMING:[/b][/h2][p]The departure window will be open between the 7th of July 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT and the 21st of July 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT. You will have 14 days to sign up and complete the requirements and all players who have signed up will depart automatically.[/p][p][/p][p]As with all previous Expeditions, completing your Caravan does not count as signing up for the Expedition, you still have to sign up during the window. The ‘last call’ feature will also be active during this Expedition in case you miss the window.
[/p][p][b]Expeditions are a personal progression that players complete in order. The Caravan can be completed in between Expedition windows but finishing the Expedition can only be done during the scheduled Expedition window.

[/b][/p][h2][b]HOW TO DO THE EXPEDITION:[/b][/h2][olist][*][p][b]Complete the Caravan[/b]
The option to contribute to the Caravan starts as soon as you complete the previous Expedition and if this is your first Expedition, you can start contributing right away.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wait for the Expedition Window[/b]
The next window opens on July 7th at 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT and closes on July 21st at 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sign Up[/b]
Once the Expedition window opens, you need to sign up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Complete the Challenge[/b]
In order to get the rewards, players will need to complete a challenge within the Expedition Window (more details below).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Catch Up[/b]
Catch up on missed skill points (max 5 per Expedition) for players on their second, third or fourth Expedition (more details below).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Depart[/b]
Everyone that signed up departs on July 21st at 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h2][b]REWARDS:[/b][/h2][p]The rewards depend on your personal progression which means that if you’re doing your first, second or third Expedition, you can check your rewards [u][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/a-triumphant-exit"]here[/url][/u]. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Mystery Rewards[/b][/h3][p]Players embarking on their fourth Expedition will no longer earn Skill Points from the Expedition Challenge. Instead, you'll receive Blueprints and Raider Tokens, delivered after your departure.  [/p][p]The number of rewards you receive is based on damage dealt during the departure window, using the same thresholds as the previous Expedition. Note that unlike Skill Points, these rewards have no catch-up mechanic. 
[/p][p]This is the first time we are trying the Mystery Reward system and we will be monitoring it closely to see how it performs and analyse your feedback. As always, we may make changes in the future as we continue to try to improve 
[/p][p]To claim all five Bonus Rewards, hit the following damage thresholds before the departure window closes: [/p][list][*][p]Reward 1: Deal 5 000 total damage [/p][/*][*][p]Reward 2: Deal 10 000 total damage [/p][/*][*][p]Reward 3: Deal 30 000 total damage [/p][/*][*][p]Reward 4: Deal 50 000 total damage [/p][/*][*][p]Reward 5: Deal 100 000 total damage [/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/86657b8754bb1236ca6d2e68bd2844e53bc97d84.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Blueprints [/b][/p][p]Each completed departure objective rewards you with one Blueprint. Keep in mind that these Blueprints are temporary and will reset when you depart on your next Expedition. The Damage Challenge rewards are safeguarded against duplicates, meaning you won't receive the same Blueprint twice. However, this protection does not extend to the Blueprints you have carried over in Ermal's Vault. [/p][list][*][p][b]List of potential Blueprints: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Heavy Gun Parts Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Complex Gun Parts Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Padded Stock Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Extended Barrel III Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Muzzle Brake III Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Stable Stock III Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Vertical Grip III Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Venator Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Rascal Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Osprey Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Trailblazer Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Anvil Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Bettina Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Hullcracker Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Tempest Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Vulcano Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Dolabra Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Aphelion Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Augment Mk 3 Flanking Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Tactical Augment Mk 3 Defensive Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Looting Augment Mk 3 Safekeeper Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Looting Augment Mk 3 Survivor Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Wolfpack Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Powered Descender Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Snap Hook Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Raider Tokens[/b] [/p][p]150 Raider Tokens will be rewarded for completing each departure objective. Unlike Blueprints, they are permanent and will not reset with the next Expedition.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/4237a233197f686f537acbf29bb828a138cd49b1.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Permanent[/b][/h3][p][b]Cosmetics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now that the Patchwork Outfit is complete, doing your fourth Expedition will unlock the first step of the Zenith Outfit.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bonuses:[/b][/p][list][*][p]+12 stash space (48 extra total for 4th Expedition), will be maxed out at 60 with the 5th Expedition.[/p][/*][*][p]The bonus skill points from Expeditions cap at 15. Players can still catch-up on previously missed skill points and it’s still tied to stash value. Catch-up for skill points becomes available with your second Expedition and once you get all the maximum 15 skill points, the catch-up is no longer available.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Consecutive buffs[/b][/h3][p]Consecutive buffs are granted to Raiders that continue to do Expeditions in a row. The XP boost, Scrappy materials boost and repair value increase are capped at three levels, meaning that if this is your fourth Expedition in a row, the boosted values will be maintained from your third Expedition but not increased.[/p][p][/p][p]Missing an Expedition window doesn’t remove the progress but will result in the buffs not increasing for the next Expedition period. The buff itself is also not active during the period of the missed Expedition.[/p][p][/p][p]You need to do two Expeditions in a row in order to increase the buffs which means if this is your third Expedition in a row, you will get all three levels of the consecutive buffs. If you missed one Expedition window apart from the first one, you should have the second level of the consecutive buffs. [/p][h2][/h2][h3][b]Ermal’s Vault[/b][/h3][p]You can purchase up to five Expedition Vault Slots through Ermal which allows you to store items that you wish to bring with you on your Expedition. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Trials[/b][/h3][p]Just like the previous Expedition, the new Trials Season will start as soon as the Expedition window opens.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Raiders & Future Expeditions[/b][/h3][p]We understand the frustration of new players that are only now starting to do their Expeditions. We need to find the right balance of rewarding our veteran players but also give new players fair and fun ways to catch up and not feel like they are always behind. This is a continuous effort and we'll keep you updated as we have more to share.
[/p][p]Let us know what you think of these changes and how they feel in practice and keep up the feedback of what you’d like to see in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]See you Topside,[/p][p]//Ossen[/p][p]And The ARC Raiders Team[/p]

title: Notes on The Matchmaking System
author: embark_ossen
contents:
[p]You’ve probably seen plenty of discussion about matchmaking in [b]ARC Raiders[/b]. We’ve been reading it too - and we want to bring some clarity to what the system is trying to do, what it does in practice, and what it doesn’t do.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What we strive for[/b][/h2][p]In the Rust Belt, the kind of Raider you become should be up to you.[/p][p]Topside works because it’s unpredictable. You can never be sure if you can trust the people you meet, or how dangerous they might be. That freedom - and the uncertainty it creates - is what drives the tension, the encounters, and the choices that make every run feel like its own story.[/p][p]At the same time, we don’t want dedicated PvP players to consistently steamroll Raiders who aren’t as interested in PvP, or who are still finding their footing. So our matchmaking is built around two goals:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fairness:[/b] We do our best to match players who have a similar likelihood of succeeding in the round. One simple example: we prioritize matching [b]equal squad sizes[/b] where possible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enjoyment:[/b] We do our best to match players who are likely to have fun together. In practice, we’ve found that [b]matching players based on playstyle[/b] drives enjoyment and reduces friction.[/p][/*][/list][p]And like any matchmaking system, we pursue those goals while respecting real constraints, such as [b]matchmaking time [/b]and [b]latency[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Playstyle-based Matchmaking [/b][/h2][p]We take multiple factors into account when forming a lobby. One of the strongest is your [b]playstyle across previous rounds[/b], especially as it relates to how you engage with other Raiders.[/p][p]It’s important to understand that playstyles aren’t binary. This isn’t “friendly” vs. “shoot on sight.” It’s a [b]continuous scale[/b]. [/p][list][*][p]Some Raiders are almost always cooperative.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Raiders are highly engaged in PvP.[/p][/*][*][p]Most Raiders fall somewhere in between - maybe friendly until threatened, maybe opportunistic, maybe cautious, maybe unpredictable on a bad day.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our system tries to place you with players who sit [b]closer to you on that scale[/b], while still keeping Topside from becoming completely predictable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/55f2439bbc998cb9109abb1538294b194234b9da.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]What it does[/b][/h3][p]There are two simple rules to how playstyle-based matchmaking behaves:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Similarity is more likely, not guaranteed. [/b]You have a higher chance of being matched with Raiders whose past playstyle is similar to yours - and a lower chance of being matched with Raiders whose playstyle is very different. But there is no hard guarantee.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Your behavior shapes your future lobbies - gradually. [/b]If you change how you play, the kinds of Raiders you tend to meet will gradually shift over time. Your behavior influences what’s [i]most likely[/i] - but never locks you into a single experience. [/p][/*][/olist][p]This is why we see such a wide range of interactions Topside: Raiders forming impromptu musical bands and others vibing along; strangers lending a hand in a tough moment while scavengers thrive on remains; betrayals when you least expect them and justice when you need it most; firefights that start on sight - and negotiations that end with everyone walking away.[/p][p]Some outcomes are rarer than others - but they’re all part of what makes each round a unique adventure. This isn’t a full-blown attempt to segregate playstyles. Topside wouldn’t be Topside if it didn’t throw you a curveball every now and again. We want you to have fun - but danger always lurks, and you will still meet Raiders who surprise you.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Mythbusting[/b][/h2][p]We want to keep some level of mystery in matchmaking, because unpredictability is part of the experience - but we [i]can[/i] clear up a few common myths:[/p][list][*][p][b]There are not only two kinds of lobbies - friendly and aggressive.[/b]
It’s a scale, not two buckets. Most players land somewhere between the extremes, and matchmaking is more likely to pair you with Raiders whose playstyle is similar to yours on that scale - without guaranteeing a specific outcome every round.[/p][/*][*][p][b]One shot or kill does not immediately put you in “PvP-focused” lobbies.[/b]
Matchmaking isn’t meant to overreact to single moments - it looks at patterns over time, and changes tend to be gradual rather than instant.[/p][/*][*][p][b]There are no “PvE-only” lobbies/servers where other Raiders will never attack you.[/b]
Topside always carries risk. You may trend toward meeting Raiders with similar preferences, but there’s no guarantee you’ll never be attacked by another Raider.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Your end-of-round feedback does not affect matchmaking. [/b]
The survey is valuable for us when we look at trends and make design decisions, but it isn’t used as a “next lobby” lever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Your loadout does not affect matchmaking.[/b]
Matchmaking isn’t driven by your kit, and we don’t scale lobby difficulty based on how much your loadout costs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Patches and updates don't reset your matchmaking profile.[/b] 
Your playstyle history carries over across patches. You may notice slightly rougher matches in the first few minutes after an update - that's just because the pool is small while players are still updating - but it recovers quickly as more Raiders come online.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Looting knocked-out players doesn't affect your matchmaking.[/b] 
Matchmaking looks at how you engage with other Raiders, not what you do with their gear afterward.[/p][/*][*][p][b]We don’t matchmake based only on the squad leader.[/b]
Each member influences the squad profile - the leader has no special weight compared to their squadmates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Turning crossplay on or off does not impact the level of cooperation / PvP in the round.[/b]
Changing crossplay changes who’s in the matchmaking pool (and thanks to that, the matchmaking time), but it doesn’t guarantee the tone of your encounters.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]New matchmaking changes[/b][/h2][p]Based on community feedback, we've identified two major shortcomings in how we used to estimate playstyle - and both are getting addressed:[/p][p][b]1. Defending yourself is no longer treated the same as starting a fight. [/b]Previously, your playstyle didn't capture whether you started a PvP encounter or merely defended yourself. This meant cautious Raiders could be treated as more PvP-focused than they actually are. Now, the two are treated differently.[/p][p][b]2. Low-activity rounds carry less weight in your playstyle history.[/b] Rounds with little Topside interaction - like spawning and surrendering - used to impact player’s estimated playstyle more than expected. Reducing their weight helps the system reflect how you genuinely play when you're out there making choices.[/p][p]These are live now, and we'll keep tuning them as we see how they play out.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Raid, your way[/b][/h2][p]To sum it up: we’re committed to making Topside more fair, more fun, and more rewarding - without sanding off the edges that make ARC Raiders what it is.[/p][p]Play how you want to play. Over time, your behavior helps shape the kinds of Raiders you’re most likely to encounter. But there will always be room for the unexpected.[/p][p]See you Topside,
[b]The ARC Raiders Team[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]
Tell us what you think - your feedback helps guide future improvements. 
Take a 5-minute survey here: [url="https://id.embark.games/id/arc-raiders/survey"][u]\[SURVEY LINK][/u][/url][/p]

title: Ensuring Fair Play
author: Embark | Raz
contents:
[p]Raiders,[/p][p][/p][p]Anti-cheat at Embark is a studio-wide effort that protects every player across our games. With ARC Raiders Riven Tides now live, we wanted to share where things stand, what we're building, and how we think about and solve the harder problems when it comes to fair play in ARC Raiders. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]How We Protect Fair Play[/b][/h2][p]Our anti-cheat stack combines kernel-level protection from Easy Anti-Cheat with detection capabilities powered by machine-learning (ML) models, trained on a constant flow of player telemetry. Several additional layers sit behind these, which we don't disclose for operational security.[/p][p][/p][p]Kernel-level detection is a necessity because most commercial cheats operate within that space. Without it, we'd have little to no visibility into the tools doing the most damage. We're currently testing a new kernel-level solution that we expect will sharpen both detection and precision throughout Speranza and the Rust Belt. [/p][p][/p][p]On the ML side, input telemetry analysis has become one of our most effective tools. We've trained and deployed a set of models dedicated to this, and we've been working with Anybrain on this research since the start.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Accessibility and Intent[/b][/h2][p]Managing accessibility devices is one of the harder problems in anti-cheat. Players who rely on this equipment need to be able to play, and because official solutions are expensive, players often use lesser-known devices to achieve the same goal. Of course, in the wrong hands, these tools can also be used to cheat.[/p][p][/p][p]The signal we care about is intent. Our systems analyze telemetry and communication patterns to distinguish legitimate accessibility use from abuse, so players who depend on these devices to play can keep playing. This is a process that continues to be refined, but we’re dedicated to the work and the results we’ve seen thus far. [/p][p][/p][p]Official devices from major platforms are well known and common, so we’re able to detect them with accuracy and understand the intent behind their use. Our partners at Anybrain are constantly expanding on their knowledge of various accessibility hardware, helping us detect more and refine the use cases, making our ML detection smarter, more reliable, and more accessible with time. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]How Ban Appeals Work[/b][/h2][p]Every ban appeal is reviewed by a person on our team. The process isn't automated, and we keep refining it as we learn more about the cases that come through. A fair and accurate appeals process matters to us across every game we make, and we treat it as a permanent area of investment rather than a finished system.[/p][p][/p][p]While it may be frustrating to wait for an answer and to get the pre-written responses that our agents need to use in order to maintain consistency, we look into each case to ensure fair gameplay and to test and refine the systems and models that have been put in place to keep the game fair and fun. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates from us in the near future! [/p][p][/p][p]Until then, we’ll see you Topside! 
[i](We’ve got eyes everywhere) [/i]
The Anti-cheat Team[/p][p]
[/p]

title: Riven Tides
author: emma.easter
contents: [p]The Riven Tides Update is the [b]sixth[/b] free content update from ARC Raiders since launch, and expands the world of the Rust Belt with the new coastal Riven Tides map, new ARC Turbine, new Beachcombing minor map condition, alongside a new player event, a player project, quality of life updates and more.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6ps42Cyz2aI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]NEW MAP: RIVEN TIDES[/b][/p][p]On the western coast of the Rust Belt lies a stretch of deserted shoreline. This location has been abandoned twice: once during the Exodus, and once again by survivors of the First Wave, who failed to hold down the exposed settlement against ARC. From the fading resort to the towering dockyard, stake your claim and discover what treasures lie within.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/6c06b27459aae6d3a59f0c1d1f458f7ee499b757.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]NEW ENEMY: ARC TURBINE[/b][/p][p]Almost beautiful when silhouetted against the sunset, the [b]ARC Turbine[/b] drifts across the Rust Belt. Calm, docile, quiet. That is until you get up close. Nobody knows quite what it’s doing, but if you try to interfere, you best be ready for a totally unique fight. Its defensive abilities are brutal, posing a new challenge to Raiders and demanding skill, patience, and nerves in equal measure. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/5cf5ef3ac34ec0791ced3b80c2280b8a63b509ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW MINOR MAP CONDITION: BEACHCOMBING[/b][/p][p]Riven Tides introduces a new minor map condition: [b]Beachcombing[/b]. Keep an eye out for the [b]Dockmaster's Detector[/b] during a session and sweep it across the sand to uncover buried loot hidden beneath the surface. What you dig up will vary, just keep in mind that the richest hunting grounds are out in the open…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/6261d9eefd96e20fab7221687b0c15b6ee70fe40.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW ITEMS: CRASH MAT AND POWERED DESCENDER[/b][/p][p]Getting from A to B is never an easy feat in the Rust Belt, but it’s even harder when A is 100 feet high and B is the hard, splatty ground. With two new fall mitigation items, skillful Raiders can learn to defy gravity, as long as they remain focused. [/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW EVENT: LAST RESORT[/b][/p][p]Running through to [b]May 25[/b], the [b]Last Resort[/b] event rewards you with Merits as your XP converts during play on any map. For bonus gains, hunt down miniature [b]Ship Models[/b] hidden throughout the world, each one carrying a Merit value based on rarity. Rack up enough Merits to unlock three pages of rewards, including the [b]Junior Outfit[/b], [b]Hydrologist[/b] backpack, [b]Hose[/b] attachment, [b]Brass Faucet[/b] charm, new emotes, and [b]250 Raider Tokens[/b] in total.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/19cc022a58d6942e30fe01d754861a23e132c352.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]NEW RAIDER PROJECT: AVIAN ALARM[/b][/p][p]The new [b]Avian Alarm[/b] Raider project tasks you with building Bird Cages as a makeshift security system to sense tremors and atmospheric changes, deploying cages at buoys along the Riven Tides coastline. Work through all five stages to earn the [b]Dockmaster's Detector[/b] (your key to Beachcombing), [b]Gel Patches[/b], the [b]Bird House[/b] backpack attachment, the [b]Fist In Air[/b] emote, and [b]250 Raider Tokens[/b] in total.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/12dcdc32587beb0967bacaf8aa9fc9fc0ce87f18.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW COSMETICS[/b][/p][p]Riven Tides brings a wave of new cosmetics, starting with two sets available on launch day. The [b]Solare Set[/b] drapes you in ceremonial layers and woven fabrics, fitting attire for those who greet the sunrise like a ritual. The [b]Rachetta Set[/b] throws subtlety overboard: bold colors, an athletic cut, and zero interest in camouflage for Raiders who rely on speed over stealth. [/p][p][/p][p]See you beachside, Raiders![/p][p][/p]

title: Riven Tides - Patch Notes Update 1.26.0
author: Lootfisk
contents:
[p]Raiders,
[/p][p]Scout reports have been returning from Riven Tides. Fragments of observation logs, faded photographs, and footage of the coast have finally made their way back to Speranza. [/p][p]
It’s now time for you to check it out for yourself. Explore the abandoned shoreline, traverse the Exodus port, and experience the lost luxury of the Panorama Azzurro hotel. [/p][p]
This is the Rust Belt, and it’s not going to be easy. Other Raiders are already on the scent of fresh loot, and a new floating ARC machine has been seen patrolling the skies. What it’s doing, and how to counter it, is for you to find out. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6ps42Cyz2aI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/8aa9183d570cf1f1e0cd43085879119bffcc9936.png"][/img][/p][h3]What’s New?[/h3][list][*][p]Riven Tides Map[/p][/*][*][p]Beachcombing Map Condition[/p][list][*][p]New minor Map Condition, exclusive to Riven Tides[/p][/*][*][p]Search for buried treasure on the beaches of Riven Tides, just make sure you have the right tool for the job and be prepared for unexpected discoveries.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Enemy - ARC Turbine[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/a-triumphant-exit"]Expedition Window[/url][/p][/*][*][p]New Items[/p][list][*][p]Epic Gadget - Powered Descender[/p][/*][*][p]Uncommon Throwable - Crash Mat[/p][/*][*][p]Common Deployable - White Flag[/p][/*][*][p]Common Gadget - Dockmaster’s Detector[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Player Project - Avian Alarm[/p][/*][*][p]Last Resort Event: Earn merits by Collecting ship models and via XP across the different maps to earn rewards[/p][list][*][p]"Wind Sprite" Ship Model [/p][/*][*][p]"Twilight Compass" Ship Model[/p][/*][*][p]"Velocity" Ship Model[/p][/*][*][p]"Sirena Dorata" Ship Model[/p][/*][*][p]"Leviathan's Crown" Ship Model[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/quick-guide-to-trials-season-4"]Trials Season 4[/url][/p][/*][*][p]The Solare Set[/p][/*][*][p]The Rachetta Set [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New Augment: Tactical Mk.3 (Smoke)[/p][list][*][p][b]Dev note:[/b] With the addition of another Tactical Augment in this patch it is worth stating that we are aware that some Augments, particularly the Combat Augments, are not performing as well in their roles as we would like. We are working on a general balancing pass for Augments to buff some of those that are underperforming, most especially the Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking) Augment which has yet to find its place to shine. It is also a goal to develop the full roster of Augments to ensure that all categories are well represented.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][url="https://arcraiders.com/news/riven-tides -"]Check out the blog for more info![/url] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/1055b1a0222209e02d2eeef96c9c57e63c356a99.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Patch Highlights:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Trigger ‘Nade balancing[/p][/*][*][p]Repairing changes[/p][/*][*][p]Bettina Buff[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
[b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p][b]Weapon Economy Adjustments[/b][/p][p]The weapon economy has increasingly started looking more and more unbalanced, where players engaging in heavy PVP have to make a lot of difficult decisions around their weapons while the most friendly players have ended up in a chronic state of weapon accumulation. We want to balance this out so that all players are challenged by weapon attrition, as well as introducing new ways to combat it. 
[/p][p][b]New feature: Repair on upgrade[/b][/p][p]Weapon upgrading becomes very expensive when you feel like you have to repair the weapon beforehand, making it less accessible than we would like. To give more ways to repair low durability weapons and elevate the upgrade loop:[/p][list][*][p][b]Upgrading weapons will now repair 25% of the weapons max durability[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]
Weapon drop & durability[/b][/p][p]We're reducing weapon spawn around the outskirts of the maps to increase value and tension of high tier areas and locked rooms.[/p][p]We're also increasing the range of durability a weapon can spawn with, as well as reducing the average outside of locked rooms. This should be easily recouped by the new repair on upgrade.[/p][list][*][p]Avg durability on spawned weapons: 50 -> [b]30[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]These changes mean that you might find a weapon on the outskirts with 15 durability but will still find weapons around 60 durability in locked rooms.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon durability loss on shot[/b][/p][p]We've heard a clear frustration that maintaining high tier weapons is very expensive compared to the lower tier ones. We want high tier weapons to have more longevity compared to low tier weapons, so we're adjusting durability loss on shot to match this:[/p][list][*][p]Common weapons:[b] +75% durability loss on shot[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Uncommon weapons:[b] +50% durability loss on shot[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Rare weapons:[b] +35% durability loss on shot[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Epic weapons: [b]-5% durability loss on shot[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Legendary weapons:[b] -10% durability loss on shot[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapon durability loss on being knocked out[/b][/p][p]We want heavy PVP to be a viable way to play ARC Raiders, and to align this playstyle with other ways to play, we're reducing durability loss on weapons when a player is knocked out by 50%.[/p][list][*][p]Durability loss on weapons of knocked out player: -30% durability -> [b]-15% durability[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]
ARC[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed Comets from standard sessions in the Dam Battlegrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Firefly presence heavily in Dam Battlegrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Comet presence in Buried City.[/p][list][*][p][b]Dev note:[/b] The addition of Comets and Fireflies raised the difficulty in beginner-oriented sessions a bit too much, and to bring that experience back to the intended level we opted to reduce their presence in the sessions that were affected the most.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/89ae673f3dd7e381bb3fe5e697892f7de636a36e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][p]Stella Montis[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted Exodus recyclables loot distribution to be more evenly spread across containers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Items[/b][/p][p]Vaporizer Regulator[/p][list][*][p] Stack size increased 1 -> 3[/p][/*][/list][p]Trigger 'Nade[/p][list][*][p][b]Dev Note: [/b]You can no longer throw a new grenade at the same time as triggering a previously thrown one, and will instead have to wait for the animations to finish. This should reduce Trigger 'Nade spam by increasing the delay between each grenade, and effectively remove the ability to prematurely detonate a second grenade with the first one. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a 1s delay after using the throw action, before allowing the next throw/trigger action[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 1.3s delay after using the trigger action, before allowing the next throw/trigger action[/p][/*][/list][p]Photoelectric Cloak[/p][list][*][p]Increasing weight of Photoelectric Cloak from 1 -> 3 to bring it more in line with its rarity/cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Power use rate from 2.5/s to 10/s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dev Note: [/b]The Photoelectric Cloak has been quite aggressively over-performing, especially in regards to the length of time it can be activated.  This change is intended to add more intentionality between uses; it still has the same strength while activated, but now you might need to find cover sooner, or think more about how you approach areas heavily contested by ARC.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Weapons[/b][/p][p]Bettina Balancing[/p][p][b]Dev Note:[/b] The Bettina has been buffed to push it closer to its rarity. The base damage and damage against ARC armor has been increased to get more value out of each bullet, but the base fire-rate has also been reduced. The dispersion has been adjusted to support firing the weapon in longer bursts before losing accuracy, and the stack size of heavy ammo has also been increased to make it less punishing to bring the ammo you need. These changes should make each shot matter more, while also providing the ability to land more shots if you control your bursts well.[/p][list][*][p]Base Damage increased from 14 to 16[/p][/*][*][p]Base Fire-Rate reduced from 285 to to 235[/p][/*][*][p]Per Shot Dispersion reduced by around 40% (Making it bloom slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Dispersion Recovery Time improved by around 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Damage against ARC armor increased by around 33%[/p][/*][/list][p]Heavy Ammo[/p][list][*][p]Stack Size increased from 40 to 60[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/45e0209980c5259b1ca18842ebb2629c97216cee.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Content and Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p][b]ARC[/b][/p][p]General[/p][list][*][p]Fixed aim assist not targeting leg joints and weak spots on Bastion, Bombardier, Queen, and Matriarch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Vaporizer and ARC Surveyor patrols could stop moving until alerted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ARC enemies did not react to nearby breaching sounds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bastion[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Bastion could be too accurate when switching targets mid-fire.[/p][/*][/list][p]Vaporizers [/p][list][*][p]Added to more maps and conditions.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
