title: SHROUDED SKY - Patch Notes 1.17.0
author: embark_julia
contents:
[p]Attention Raiders!
[/p][p]Violent hurricanes are sweeping topside, forcing new strategies for low-visibility combat, powerful gales, and hurtling debris. Scouts have spotted two new ARC types in the Rust Belt; we advise caution while the storm runs its course, but those who know how to read the weather will find opportunity in the chaos.[/p][h2]
What’s New?[/h2][list][*][p]Hurricane Map Condition[/p][/*][*][p]Two New ARC Enemies[/p][/*][*][p]The Weather Monitoring System - Seasonal Player Project[/p][/*][*][p]Free Raider Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Dam Battlegrounds Map Update[/p][/*][*][p]Expedition Window[/p][/*][*][p]Facial Hair Customization[/p][/*][/list][p]Read more here: [url="https://arcraiders.com/news/shrouded-sky-content-update"]https://arcraiders.com/news/shrouded-sky-content-update[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/44d10ec63bc58c57ca43930c78da4528a3d54ca6.png"][/img][/p][h2]Patch Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Weapon balancing for Stitcher, Kettle, Venator, Jupiter and Aphelion.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a piano as an interactable object in the world.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented enabling all NVIDIA Freestyle filters simultaneously to remove an unfair visual advantage.[/p][/*][*][p]Feats can now be rerolled three times per day for free.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed PvP Feats, updated a few existing Feats and added a few new ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Ziplines can no longer be placed on carryable objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Mines, traps, or remote flares can no longer be placed on other deployables.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][h3]Weapons[/h3][p]In 1.13 we shipped an update that included an optimization fix for our weapons, but as many of you noticed this had the unforeseen consequence of lowering the total fire-rate of semi-automatic weapons. In 1.13.1 we reverted that fix, but something else made it into the update that shouldn't have. 
[/p][p]Many of you have reported a "shadow buff" to the weapons, and after investigating it we found that 1.13.1 had inadvertently impacted our weapon input buffers. Where you previously would have to time your inputs to the intended cadence of a weapon to reach its full potential, you could now instead spam-click the button, effectively bypassing any skill requirement to learn the weapon's cadence. We want to keep some of that skill expression, but we also recognize that what we had previously didn't feel very responsive. To address that and land in some sort of middle ground, we have since added more levers for us to control the weapon input buffering window on a gun-to-gun basis, and we've adjusted the semi-automatic weapons accordingly. The weapons should now still be more responsive to fire when spam-clicking, but the players who choose to pace their shots will see better results.
[/p][p]In addition to these changes, we've also been looking into the balance between our low tier and high tier weapons. A lot of you have expressed concerns that some low tier weapons outperform our higher tier weapons at significantly reduced cost, and we're hoping to shift that balance a bit while still keeping some of that flexibility to punch above your weight if you are skilled enough. We're starting by reducing the overall TTK of the Stitcher and Kettle, and increasing the maneuverability of the Aphelion and Jupiter. We're also taking a second stab at the Venator, which still seems to be dominating a lot of our PvP encounters.
[/p][p]Stitcher[/p][p][b]Dev Note: [/b]The Stitcher has played its role well as a close quarter weapon that rewards thoughtful positioning, but we've found that its fast TTK can sometimes lead to situations where you're ambushed and killed before you have much time to react. As many of you have pointed out, the high headshot damage is a large contributor to this problem. The TTK is often fine when the weapon is aimed at the center of mass, but when you get close enough to land the majority of the shots in your target's head, we see TTK numbers that are much faster than other weapons. These changes aim to bring that headshot TTK a bit closer to the body shot TTK by both reducing the full-spray accuracy of the weapon, and reducing the headshot multiplier.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced Headshot Multiplier from 2.5 to 1.75[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Base Damage from 7 to 6.5[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Per Shot Dispersion by around 50% (Making it bloom faster)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Kettle[/p][p][b]Dev Note: [/b]The Kettle has been in a bit of a weird place. Its high damage output was intended to be used in a more medium range setting at a more deliberate pace, but we see many of you bringing it up in close quarters and effectively turning into an SMG. We want to distinguish it more from the Stitcher, but we also see that you enjoy the versatility of this weapon. So we're reducing the base damage to bring its TTK more in line, but we're keeping the high headshot multiplier to see if we can push players to go for more headshots.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced Base Damage from 10 to 8.5
[/p][/*][/list][p]Venator[/p][p][b]Dev Note:[/b] Since the last nerfs to the Venator in 1.3.0, we've kept an eye on our data to see how it performs. During this time many of you have raised concerns that it's still dominating in PVP, and our data has shown that it is one of the highest performing weapons in the game right now. For a weapon of this tier we want it to perform well, but maybe not this well. We're looking at an overall nerf to its damage to bring down its TTK, and if that doesn't work we might need to look into its ammo consumption and cost efficiency.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced Headshot Multiplier from 2.5 to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Base Damage from 9 to 8[/p][/*][/list][p]
Jupiter[/p][p][b]Dev Note: [/b]In PVP, the Jupiter does the most headshot damage in the game, but it's quite difficult to hit headshots with it at longer ranges. You're also quite vulnerable when you use it in closer ranges since missing one shot will make you a sitting target until you either reload or swap weapons. We're increasing how much you zoom when you use ADS to give you a better view of the targets you're trying to hit, and we're reducing its equip and unequip time to make it easier to swap to a secondary weapon to follow up on your shot.[/p][list][*][p]Improved ADS Magnification from ~1.9x to ~2.2x[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Equip Time from 1.2s to 1.05s[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Unequip Time from 0.9s to 0.75s[/p][/*][/list][p]
Aphelion[/p][p][b]Dev Note: [/b]We weren't quite happy with the previous balancing of the Aphelion. It was intended to be a more PVP focused legendary weapon, but it couldn't quite keep up with the pacing of many of our other PVP weapons. We've made some changes to make it feel less bulky and a bit more nimble to use, to make it more viable in PVP.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced Base Reload Time from 4.5s to 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Time Between Shots from 0.9s to 0.7s[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Vertical Recoil by ca 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Improved ADS Settle Speed by ca 35%[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Item and Crafting[/h3][p]Energy clip[/p][list][*][p]Now available by default in the Workbench.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Item Value and Cost Changes[/p][p]Following item values and costs have been adjusted with appropriate recycle and salvaging adjustments:[/p][list][*][p][b]Deadline[/b][/p][list][*][p]Value increased from 5,000 to 6,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Trader price increased from 15,000 to 18,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new ARC part as a crafting cost.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Trailblazer[/b][/p][list][*][p]Value Advanced Electrical Components to Electrical Components.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]ARC Parts sell value has been reduced to better reflect their crafting and progression might not appear correctly in the event preview.[/p][/*][*][p]‘Comparative Study’ achievement sometimes does not progress correctly after damaging the hanging drone dummies.[/p][/*][*][p]The 'Unyielding' achievement/trophy fails to progress on console when knocking out raiders using the associated prompt.[/p][/*][*][p]Some unintended VFX can appear occasionally.[/p][/*][*][p]One of the new ARC enemies[b] [/b]has an unusable interaction occasionally when destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Flying ARC may sometimes appear stuck in idle.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes the Embark ID Discriminator fails to show.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing LMB outside of the item select area closes the item select window in the Expeditions menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Anti-Cheat[/h2][p][/p][p]When we shared our last update about tackling unfair play, we didn’t fully convey the complexity and scale of what goes into cheat detection. Our defenses operate on multiple levels: some checks are simple and definitive, while others are behavioral and data-driven and evolve over time. We also leverage broad gameplay telemetry and machine learning techniques to spot patterns that aren’t obvious at first glance. These methods take longer to develop, must adapt as game systems change, and don’t always offer instant certainty the way blunt software detections can.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve recently taken action against different exploits and we are further tightening our rules and stepping up enforcement. Serious infractions now carry stricter consequences. Strong detections will receive permanent bans right off the bat, while others will receive a temporary suspension and a single chance to correct the behavior. Recent updates to Family Sharing have strengthened our ability to curb misconduct and streamlined the removal of bad actors from the game. We are preparing to launch a systematic manual review of ban appeals. The game is young and the volume of telemetry is enormous, but this process ensures every case is handled with care as we continue to learn quickly and invest heavily in the precision of our enforcement tools.[/p][p][/p][p]Our dedicated anti-cheat team works tirelessly to keep the game fair. It’s an ongoing fight, and we’re committed to it.[/p][p][/p][p]//Ossen[/p][p]And the ARC Raiders Team[/p]

title: SHARED WATCH - Patch Notes 1.15.0
author: embark_julia
contents:
[p]Raiders,
[/p][p]What happens topside, stays topside - Raiders have to leave their grudges at the tubes. 
[/p][p]But Speranza also has a conscience. While Raider violence can’t be totally controlled, Celeste is keen to remind us why we took refuge under the dust of the Rust Belt; and that just because we live in the dirt, we don’t always have to act like it. 
[/p][p]The Shared Watch is an annual holiday that reminds us of the true enemy, by celebrating those that look out for their fellow Raiders. Tolerate, team-up, or take out some ARC - it’s all in the spirit of the Shared Watch.
[/p][h2]What’s New?[/h2][list][*][p][b]SHARED WATCH [/b][/p][/*][/list][p]This is an opportunity to team up in the fight against the machines. 
[/p][p]The Shared Watch Event starts today and ends on February 24. Players will earn merits from destroying, assisting and damaging ARC and earn rewards. No merits will be earned from PvP encounters. Bring a friend or bring a stranger, but above all, bring enough ammo to make sure the machines notice you first.
[/p][list][*][p][b]Cold Snap Map Condition[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Winter is not quite done with the Rust Belt - We are bringing back Cold Snap![/p][p]The map condition is back in rotation on outdoor maps with the same mix of risk and reward. Frostbite damage will make your trip topside a short one if you don’t seek shelter, but for those who do brave the tundra - there’s increased loot value at stake! [/p][p]You can still collect Candleberries, but they are no longer tied to any event. You can also collect, and throw, snowballs! Use them wisely, or don't.
[/p][list][*][p][b]Cosmetics[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The Vulpine set[/p][p]The Slugger set

title: Preparing for your Second Expedition
author: embark_julia
contents:
[p]Raiders![/p][p][/p][p]It will soon be time to open up the tunnels out of Speranza and send our second wave of ambitious Raiders to new adventures beyond the Rust Belt. [/p][p][/p][p]Raiders can sign up from February 25th and the departure will take place on March 1st. This is your opportunity to start your journey again with a new Raider and extra buffs and bonuses.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Before the expedition, we want to give you all the information you need so you can prepare ahead of time.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Starting off, we want to get one announcement out of the way right off the bat: we’ve heard your feedback about the required Stash value for maximum rewards being too high, and have decided to lower the requirement to 3 million Coins (600k per Skill Point). The reward will still be 5 Skill Points for reaching the 3 million Stash value. [/p][p][/p][h2]Catch Up Mechanic[/h2][p]For Raiders who could not amass enough Coins during the first Expedition, we are introducing a Skill Point catch up system allowing Raiders to reclaim the ones they missed. The catch up Skill Points will be heavily discounted, making the total Coins needed to reach max Skill Points less for each Expedition. Amass the entire Stash value and enjoy your Skill Points before everyone else, fail to do so and the catch-up system will allow you to close the gap over time.[/p][p][/p][p]For this Expedition, you will need to gather 300k Stash value per Skill Point missing from the first Expedition. When departing, Coins will contribute to the Skill Points of the second Expedition, before contributing to missing Skill Points from the first one.[/p][p][/p][p]Bear in mind that the rewards and requirements may change for future expeditions and bonus Skill Points won’t be available indefinitely for those that continue to depart.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/ba3ea4f6fd9928dc960565ed266dbc0230f4b5a7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Rewards, stacks, and additions[/h2][p]Players who will be doing the Expedition for the first time will get the rewards from the first Expedition (read more [url="https://arcraiders.com/news/the-expedition-project-is-departing-soon"][u]here[/u][/url]). [/p][p][/p][p]For those who continue to depart, more Stash space and Skill Points will be awarded. Permanent bonuses that have been earned on previous expeditions will be retained by Raiders even if they choose to not depart again. The Patchwork outfit will get four additional toggles and two new colour options for those joining their second Expedition as well as a new Scrappy outfit. Buffs will stack for those who continue to depart on consecutive Expeditions but will be reset for those who decide not to depart again. [/p][p][/p][p]The Trophy Display Project, along with your cosmetics, any Raider Deck progress, unlocked map regions, leaderboard position and Trials, Codex entries, and Raider Tokens will not be affected by the Expedition.[/p][h3]Permanent[/h3][list][*][p][b]Cosmetics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Patchwork outfit (evolved)[/p][/*][*][p]Scrappy cosmetics[/p][/*][*][p]The Expedition Indicator icon (upgraded for each expedition completed)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bonuses:[/b][/p][list][*][p]12→24 Stash spaces[/p][/*][*][p]+0-5 Skill Points (+ catch up on missed Skill Points from the first Expedition, so 85 total is possible for those embarking on their second Expedition)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Consecutive[/h3][list][*][p][b]Buffs:[/b][/p][list][*][p]5%→10% XP boost[/p][/*][*][p]6%→12% Scrappy materials boost[/p][/*][*][p]60%→70% Repair value increase
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/3f0d5fa286d4d522aec55d81dc82371d9af2d52d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Good luck out there, Raiders.[/p][p]The ARC Raiders Team[/p]

contents:
[p]Raiders,[/p][p][/p][p]Trouble is brewing in the Rust Belt. [/p][p][/p][p]Heavy sandstorms have been battering the surface. Flocks of birds have been spotted around Buried City, gathering around chimneys for what many assume to be nefarious reasons. And to top it all off, maverick Raiders have been spotted hunting ARC for sport, and single-handedly taking on entire squads. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]What’s New?[/h2][list][*][p][b]Solo vs Squads[/b][/p][list][*][p]Solo vs Squads is a new matchmaking option for our experienced and highly skilled players who enjoy the PvP aspect of the game. Solo Raiders level 40 and above will get the "Solo vs Squad" toggle above matchmaking to join the Squads queue and tackle squads of Raiders head-on. When opting in, players will receive +20% bonus XP at the end of the round on both successful extract, and defeat.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Trophy Display[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new long-term project which requires players to hunt increasingly dangerous groups of ARC to submit their parts for rewards. Raiders will be able to build a new Display Case over 5 different steps (same as for the Candleberry Project) and each level will add a new item to the Display Case.[/p][/*][*][p]The rewards for completing each step include blueprints as well as Raider Tokens, and full completion also brings additional rewards including a Howl emote, a guitar and 300,000 Coins. There is currently no fixed end date and it will not be impacted by Expedition resets.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bird City[/b][/p][list][*][p]Flocks of birds have moved into Buried City, building nests in the empty chimneys. We got some reports of them storing shiny trinkets inside so make sure to inspect them. This new permanent map condition will be applied to the Buried City map only which will cycle in and out of rotation weekly. There will be more bird traps and ziplines present on the map. Raiders can expect more combat in, on, or around the rooftops, including more flying ARC, and more players in proximity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]2 new types of Epic Augments[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]7 New Quests[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Patch Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Open Parties[/p][list][*][p]The option to set your party to open so your added.[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad rebinding.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/865f9db8a7925740ee2777d61901b547db649636.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][/h2][h2]Content and Bug title: COLD SNAP
author: embark_julia
contents: [p]Frigid winds carve through the valleys of The Blue Gate. Blizzards sweep across the abandoned spaceport while the Red Lakes freeze and crack. Raiders Topside battle on as they shiver and stumble and swear.[/p][p]Due for release on December 16th 2025, the Cold Snap update is the second content update from ARC Raiders since launch, and brings:  [/p][list][*][p][b]New Cold Snap Map Condition[/b] — Winter variant across Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City, Spaceport and The Blue Gate maps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold-Weather Survival Mechanics[/b] — Exposure to extreme cold causes frostbite, encouraging new strategies around healing items, loadouts, and indoor shelter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two Seasonal Challenges + Rewards [/b]— Unique loot and rewards available through the Flickering Flames event and Candleberry Banquet project.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Second Free Raider Deck Added on December 26[/b] — The Goalie Raider deck will now be included in the base game, bringing players 5 pages of unlockable rewards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]COLD SNAP MAP CONDITION[/b][/p][p]A cold front has swept in with snowfall, and a considerable drop in temperature. The air might feel crisp and brisk at first, but beware of frostbite![/p][p]The new map conditions are opt-in and will be in rotation on Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City, Spaceport and The Blue Gate maps for a limited period of time, ending in January.[/p][p]The new map condition includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Unique Loot Assets[/b]: Visually distinct Candleberry bushes which drop Candleberries, used for the Candleberry Banquet.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Snow and Frost:[/b] The inclement weather brings challenges. Raiders may take frostbite damage if they spend too long outside.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/63e6a8af6e13d6c81ed21283f7f8c97b2b959b53.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]FLICKERING FLAMES LIVE EVENT[/b][/p][p]The Flickering Flames event is a personal progression type event. There are 25 levels to unlock and exciting rewards for each, including new gear and customizations, and even some Raider Tokens.[/p][list][*][p]Raiders progress through the event by earning Merits. These are automatically converted from your XP earned by playing on any map.[/p][/*][*][p]Raiders can also earn additional Merits by participating in the Candleberry Banquet event (see below)[/p][/*][*][p]In order to activate the event, Raiders must first have played 5 rounds in the game.[/p][/*][*][p][i]The event starts on Dec 16 at 10.30 CET and ends on Jan 13 at 10.30 CET[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/b7f9494f29d58abb74ac04ca326114b28c48efb4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]CANDLEBERRY BANQUET PROJECT[/b][/p][p]The Candleberry Banquet is a Project where Raiders can earn rewards for scavenging specific items topside and collecting Candleberries.  It runs alongside the Flickering Flames Live event.[/p][list][*][p]Unlock 5 project stages, each stage completes a new scene on the banquet table.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing levels earns you rewards, which include a new cosmetic item and Raider Tokens. Raiders can also earn Merits, which can be used to help complete the Flickering Flames event.[/p][/*][*][p][i]The project starts on Dec 16 at 10.30 CET and ends on Jan 13 at 10.30 CET[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]GOALIE RAIDER DECK (From December 26)[/b][/p][p]The Goalie Raider Deck is a winter hockey-inspired deck which will be permanently added to the base game and is available for free from Dec 26.[/p][list][*][p]It features a hockey-inspired Raider outfit in several color variants, along with a hockey stick Raider tool.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can also unlock 5 pages of rewards including Raider tokens, and gameplay as well as cosmetic items, using their Cred.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/211f5f003c9a237eb5ea9143b51b32b850092b1a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There’s no time to lose[i] [/i]- this event will run [b]from December 16th[/b] [b]until January 13th[/b], so put on your warmest gear and get up there. [/p][p]But remember, this cold is no joke.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay warm. Stay alive.[/p][p]The ARC Raiders team[/p]

title: COLD SNAP - December Update 1.7.0 Patch Notes
author: embark_julia
contents:
[p]Raiders,
[/p][p]Frigid winds carve through the valleys of Blue Gate. Blizzards sweep across the abandoned spaceport while the Red Lakes freeze and crack. Raiders topside battle on as they shiver and stumble and swear.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]What’s New?
[/h2][p][b]Cold Snap Map Condition[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Flickering Flames Event[/b]
[/p][p][b]Expedition Departure Window[/b]
[/p][p][b]New Free Raider Deck “Goalie” [/b] - coming on December 26
[/p][p][b]New Quests and Items[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Patch Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Added Skill Tree Reset functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to toggle Aim Down Sights.[/p][/*][*][p]Wallet now shows your Cred soft cap.[/p][/*][*][p]Various festive items to get you into the holiday spirit.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the Aphelion blueprint drop from the Matriarch to Stella Montis.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Raider Tool customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various collision issues on maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Stella Montis spawn distance checks to address the issue of players spawning too close to each other.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][h3]Weapons:[/h3][p]Bettina[/p][p][b]Dev note: [/b]These changes aim to make the Bettina a bit less reliant on bringing a secondary weapon. The weapon should now be a bit more competent in PVP, without tipping the scales too much. Data shows that this weapon is still the highest performing PVE weapon at its rarity (Not counting the Hullcracker). The durability should also feel more in line with our other assault rifles.[/p][list][*][p]Durability Burn Rate has been reduced from ~0.43% to ~0.17% per shot[/p][list][*][p]In practice, it used to take about 12 full magazines to fully deplete durability, but now it takes 26 (also accounting for the increased magazine size).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Base Magazine Size has been increased from 20 to 22[/p][/*][*][p]Base Reload Time has been reduced from 5 to 4.5[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Rattler[/p][p][b]Dev note:[/b] Even though the Rattler isn't intended to compete with the Stitcher or Kettle at close ranges, it is receiving a minor buff to bring its PVP TTK at lower levels a bit closer to the Stitcher and Kettle. The weapon should remain in its intended role as a more deliberate weapon where players are expected to dip in and out of cover, fire in controlled bursts, and manage their reloads.[/p][list][*][p]Base Magazine Size has been increased from 10 to 12[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]ARC:[/h3][p]Shredder[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the amount of knockback applied by weapons. Increased movement speed and turning responsiveness.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased health of the Shredder's head to prevent cases where its head could be shot off, leading to unintended behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Shredder navigation to reduce getting stuck on corners, narrow spaces, and short obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed at which the Shredder enters combat when taking damage and when in close proximity to players.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of parts on the Shredder that can be individually destroyed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]Content and Bug Fixes [/h2][h3]Achievements[/h3][list][*][p]Achievements are now enabled in the Epic store.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Animation [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where picking up a Field Crate with a Trigger ’Nade attached could cause the character to slide or move without input.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where combining Snap Hook with ziplines or ladders could store momentum and propel the player long distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the running animation could appear incorrect after a small drop when over-encumbered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed interaction animations: interactions now end correctly when performing a dodge roll; interacting while holding items or deployables no longer causes arm twisting; updated crouch repair to use the correct animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added physical based secondary movement to character skins and equipment.[/p][/*][/list][h3]ARC[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where deployables attached to enemies could cause them to launch or clip out of bounds when shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Missiles no longer reverse course after passing a target and can correctly track targets at different elevations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sentinel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Sentinel laser did not reach the targeted player over greater distances.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Surveyor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Disabled vaulting onto ARC Surveyors to prevent unintended launches when they are moving.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bombardier projectiles could shoot through the Matriarch shield from the outside.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Gas, Stun, and Impulse Mines did not play their trigger sound or switch their light to yellow when triggered by being shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of simultaneous footstep sounds and increased their priority.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where footsteps in metal stairs became very quiet when walking slowly.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved directional sound for ARC enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sounds for sending and receiving text chat messages in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the unsettling "mom?" from Speranza cantina ambient sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the loudness of announcements in various Main Menu screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Number of small audio bugfixes and polish.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Maps [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with spawning logic which could cause players who were reconnecting at the start of a session to spawn next to other players who had just joined.[/p][/*][*][p]Various collision, geometry, VFX and texture fixes that address gaps in terrain which made players fall through the map or walk inside geometry, stuck spots, camera clipping through walls, see-through geometry, floating objects, texture overlaps, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the slope of the Raider Hatch that was too steep for downed raiders to crawl on top of it.[/p][/*][*][p]Security Lockers are now dynamically spawned across all maps instead of being statically placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Raider Caches not spawning during Prospecting Probes in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lootable containers and Supply Drops spawning inside terrain on The Dam and Blue Gate, ensuring they are accessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where doors could appear closed for some players despite being open.[/p][/*][*][p]Electromagnetic Storm: Lightning strikes sometimes leave behind a valuable item.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of possible Great Mullein spawn locations across all maps.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dam Battlegrounds[/b][/p][list][*][p]Moved the Matriarch's spawn point in Dam Battlegrounds to an area that better plays to her strengths.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Spaceport[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the locked room protection area in Container Storage on Spaceport to not affect players outside the room.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Blue Gate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Locked Gate map condition has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted map bounds near a ledge in Blue Gate to improve navigation and reduce abrupt out-of-bounds stops.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tree LODs in Blue Gate to reduce overly dark visuals at distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where loot would spawn outside the Locked Room in the Village.[/p][/*][*][p]Added props and visual cues to the final camp in the quest ‘A First Foothold’ to make objective locations easier to find.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stella Montis[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased some item and blueprint spawn rates in Stella Montis.[/p][/*][*][p]Some breachable containers on Stella Montis no longer drop Rubber Ducks when using the A Little Extra skill (sorry).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted window glass clarity in Stella Montis to improve visibility.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]General crash fixes (including AMD crashes).[/p][/*][*][p]Added Skill Tree Reset functionality in exchange for Coins, 2,000 Coins per skill point.[/p][/*][*][p]Wallet now shows your Cred soft cap (800).[/p][list][*][p]Dev note: We decided to implement a cap so that players won’t be able to fully unlock new Raider Decks by accumulating Cred and added more items to Shani’s store to purchase using Cred. We believe that the Raider Decks offer a rewarding experience to enjoy while players engage with the game, and a large Cred wallet undermines this goal. We will not be removing Cred that has been accumulated before the introduction of the soft cap.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Raider Tool customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused players to spawn on servers without their gear and in default customization resulting in losing loadout items.[/p][/*][*][p]For ranks up to Daredevil I, leaderboards now have a 3x promotion zone for the top 5 players. New objectives have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the tutorial door breach could be canceled, preventing the cutscene from playing and blocking progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could continue breaching doors while downed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where accepting a Discord invite without having your account linked could fail to place you into the inviter’s party.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that sometimes caused textures and meshes to flicker between higher and lower quality states.[/p][/*][*][p]Depth of field amount is now scaled correctly depending on your resolution scale.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where returning to the game after alt-tabbing could prevent movement and ability inputs while camera controls still worked.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved input handling when the game window regains focus to avoid unexpected input mode switches.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill Tree[/p][list][*][p]Effortless Roll skill now provides greater stamina cost reduction.[/p][/*][*][p]The Calming Stroll skill now applies while moving in ADS.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Movement [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a traversal issue that blocked jumping/climbing in certain areas while crouched.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where climbing ladders over open gaps could cause automatic detachment.[/p][/*][*][p]A slight stamina cost has been added for entering a slide.[/p][/*][*][p]Acceleration has been reduced when doing a dodge roll from a slide.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI [/h3][list][*][p]Added an option to toggle Aim Down Sights.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new ‘Cinematic’ graphics setting to enhance visuals for high end PCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where returning to the game after alt-tabbing could prevent movement and ability inputs while camera controls still worked.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved input handling when the game window regains focus to avoid unexpected input mode switches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Codex[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved accuracy of tracking damage dealt in player stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Field-crafted items now properly count toward Player Stats in the Codex.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing sound in Codex Records.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Codex section to rewatch previously seen videos.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Console[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated PlayStation 5 controller button prompts with improved icons for Options and Share.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when using Show Profile from the Player Info on Xbox.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Customization[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now rotate your character in the customization screen. Also fixed an issue where the first equip could trigger an unintended unequip.[/p][/*][*][p]Added notifications in Character Customization to highlight recently unlocked items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where equipment customization items bought from the Loadout screen were not equipped after pressing Equip on the purchase screen.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]End of round[/b][/p][list][*][p]Further reduced the frequency of the end of round feedback survey pop up.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an optional Round Feedback button on the final end-of-round screen to open a short post-match survey.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Expedition Project[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a show/hide tooltip hint to the Raider Projects screens (Expedition and Seasonal).[/p][/*][*][p]Added 'Expeditions Completed' to Player Stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Added resource tracking for Expedition stages: Raider Projects now display required amounts and progress, with the tracker updating during rounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Added reward display to Raider Projects, showing the rewards for each goal and at Expedition completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an input conflict in Raider Projects where tracking a resource in Expeditions could also open the About Expeditions window; the on-screen prompt is now hidden while adding to Load Caravan.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Inventory[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where closing the right-click menu in the inventory could reset focus to a different slot when using a gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flickering in the inventory tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Opening the inventory during a breach now cancels the interaction to prevent a brief animation glitch.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the inventory screen layout to prevent tooltips from appearing immediately upon opening.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the weapon slot right-click menu in the inventory would not appear after navigating from an empty attachment slot with a controller.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]In-game[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the climb prompt would not appear on a rooftop ladder in Blue Gate.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where certain interaction icons could fail to appear during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "revived" events not being counted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the zipline interaction prompt could remain on a previously used zipline, preventing interaction with a new one; prompts now clear when out of range.[/p][/*][*][p]Quick equip item wheel now has a stable layout and no longer collapses items towards the top when there are empty slots in the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated in-game text across multiple languages based on localization review and player survey feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a cancel prompt when preparing to throw grenades and other throwable items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed in-game input hints to match your current key bindings and show clear hold/toggle labels. Clarified binoculars hints when using aim toggle and updated hints for SnapHook and integrated binoculars to support aiming.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial hints now stay on screen briefly after you perform the suggested action to improve readability and avoid abrupt dismissals.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where input hints could remain on screen after being downed.[/p][/*][*][p]HUD markers that are closer to the player now appear on top for improved legibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where items sometimes displayed the wrong icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where user hints were sometimes shown when spectating.[/p][/*][*][p]Strongroom racks and power stations now display a distinct color when full of carryables to indicate that it has been completed. camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly delayed the initial loot screen opening and the transition from opening to searching during interactions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Main Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a Live Events carousel to the main menu and enabled click/hover interactions on the Raider Project overview.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Weapon Upgrades tab would sometimes change location.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where a Raider could pop in and out of the home screen background.[/p][/*][*][p]Installed workstations no longer appear in the workstation install view.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now navigate from on-screen notifications to the relevant screens, including jumping directly to learned recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Upgrade Weapon Tab now accurately displays the magazine size increase.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the map screen could become unresponsive when a live event was active.[/p][/*][*][p]When inspecting items, rotating will now hide UI only showing the item being inspected.[/p][/*][*][p]Free Raider Deck content now displays as “Free” instead of “0”.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a carousel to the Main Menu featuring Quests and a Raider Deck shortcut, with improved gamepad navigation within the widget.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Scrappy screen allowed navigating to the quick navigation list when using a gamepad.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quests[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made pickups on the ground show icons if they are part of quests or tracked, added quest icons to quest interactions and improved quest interaction style.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the notification could remain after accepting and claiming quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Accepting and completing quests is now shown as loading while awaiting a server response.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rapidly skipping through quest videos after completing the first Supply Depot quest could soft‑lock the UI, leaving the screen without a way to advance.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated interaction text for a quest objective to improve clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the names and descriptions of the Moisture Probe and EC Meter quest items in Unexpected Initiative.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved ping information for quest objectives, with clearer markers for Filtration System and Magnetic Decryptor interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted colors of quest and tracking icons in in-game interaction hints for better clarity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Settings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new slider that allows players to tweak motion blur intensity.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tooltips for effects and overall quality levels in the video settings with clearer descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added labels that show whether an input action is ‘Hold’ or ‘Toggle’, displayed in parentheses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the flash effect ignored the Invert Colors setting; the option is now available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash in settings when rapidly adjusting sliders.[/p][/*][*][p]Now players will be guided to Windows settings for microphone permissions if needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when opening the video settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Options category screens continued responding to inputs after exiting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Store[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players will no longer see error messages when canceling purchases in the store.[/p][/*][*][p]Newly added store products now show a new indication for improved discoverability.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Social[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Discord friends could appear with an incorrect status after switching to Invisible and back to Online; their presence now refreshes correctly when they come back online.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Party Join icon to the social interface for clearer party invitations and joins.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Social right-click (context) menu could remain visible in the Home tab after rapidly opening and closing it with a gamepad; it now closes correctly and no longer stacks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tooltips[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect item tooltips of ARC stun duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips now reposition to remain fully visible at all resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltips showing 'Blueprint already learned' on completed goal rewards; tooltips now display correct reward information and only show 'Blueprint learned' for actual blueprints.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Trials[/b][/p][list][*][p]Trials objectives now clearly indicate when they offer bonus conditions, such as by Map Conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Trial rank icon could be missing on the Player Stats screen after starting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Trials popup that explains how ranking works and clarifies that the final rank is worldwide.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]VOIP[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Microphone Test functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Added better automatic checks for problems with VOIP input & output devices.[/p][/*][*][p]Using the mouse thumb button for push-to-talk no longer triggers ‘Back’ in menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the voice chat status icon could incorrectly appear muted for party members at match start until someone spoke.[/p][/*][*][p]HUD no longer shows VOIP icons when voice chat is disabled; your own party VOIP icon now appears as disabled.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Utility[/h3][list][*][p]Increased loot value in Epic key card rooms to better reflect their rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded blueprint spawn locations to improve availability in areas that were underrepresented.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the Aphelion blueprint drop from the Matriarch to Stella Montis.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players would sometimes become unable to perform any actions if they interacted with carriable objects while experiencing bad network conditions or were downed while holding a carriable object and then revived.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Deadline could deal damage through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where deployables attached to enemies or buildable structures could cause sudden launches or let enemies pass through the environment when shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Keys will no longer be removed from the safe pocket when using the Unload backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where cheater-compensation rewards could grant an integrated augment item.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Flame Spray dealt too much damage to some ARC.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sticky throwables (Trigger 'Nade, Snap Blast Grenade, Lure Grenade) disappeared when thrown at trees.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with incorrectly calculated deployment range for deployable items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where mines could not be triggered through damage before they were armed.[/p][/*][*][p]Playing an instrument now applies the ‘Vibing Status’ effect to nearby players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Rubber Ducks not being able to be placed into the Trinket slot on an Augment.[/p][/*][*][p]Setting integrated binoculars and integrated shield charger weight to be 0.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons [/h3][list][*][p]Tuned the amount of force applied to lighter ARC when using melee attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where stowed weapons would not appear on the first spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit allowing players to reload energy weapons without consuming ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Aiming-down-sights now resumes if it was interrupted while the aim button is still held (e.g., after reloading or a stun).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit that allowed shotguns to bypass the intended fire cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quests[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug in the ‘Greasing Her Palms’ quest that let players accidentally trigger an objective.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the quest item ESR Analyzer easier to find in Buried City.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved clarity of clues for the ‘Marked for Death’ quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where quest videos could trigger multiple times.[/p][/*][*][p]Added interactions to find spare keys to several quests related to locked rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique quest items to the ‘Unexpected Initiative’ quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where squad sharing incorrectly completed objectives that spawned quest specific items.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]Players with AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT will see a driver warning popup at startup despite being on the latest version that fixes a GPU crash that occurred when loading into The Blue Gate.[/p][/*][*][p]If you have more items than fit in your stash, the value of the items that don't fit is not included in the final departure screen, but is included when calculating your rewards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/ce22eb1d53233aefa0be48468450094ed4fca282.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay warm Raiders,[/p][p]//Ossen[/p][p]And the ARC Raiders Team[/p]

title: Patch Notes 1.6.0
author: embark_julia
contents:
[p]Raiders![/p][p]
We are rolling out an update right now, make sure to restart your client to download.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Removed a zipline that allowed players to get out of bounds on Stella Montis. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision that allowed players to vault and fall through a wall in Blue Gate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed material issues that caused multiple objects to not block bullet fire or ARC vision. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gap in the collision on Spaceport Launch Tower that allowed players to be shot through the wall.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We also want to give you a quick update on the patch cadence in the coming weeks.[/p][p]Since the release, we have been patching every Thursday to catch the most critical issues while the team was in full swing. Our goal is to continue to investigate and fix critical issues as soon as we can, but it will not be on a weekly cadence.[/p][p][/p][p]From now on, our release window and store rotation will shift to Tuesdays, however, as the winter holiday period approaches, the team will be taking a much needed break so that we can come back in January ready to bring more updates. During this time we will continue to monitor and work on critical issues.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, we are getting ready for the much larger Cold Snap update coming on Tuesday and it will bring many different fixes we have been working on along with all the new goodies.

We really appreciate all your feedback which helps us continue to improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p]See you Topside,[/p][p]//Ossen[/p]

title: Maps Feedback Survey [Closed]
author: embark_julia

title: Patch Notes 1.3.0
author: max.carlberg
contents:
[p]Raiders![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a week since we stepped into Stella Montis. We have some updates from Speranza with bug fixes, balance changes and a little surprise.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][h3]Items:[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Deadline[/b][/p][list][*][p]Buy value: From 8,100 to 15,000 Coins[/p][/*][*][p]Sell value: From 3,000 to 5,000 Coins[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting:[/p][list][*][p]Old: 2 Explosive compound + 1 Synthesized fuel[/p][/*][*][p]New: 3 Explosive compound + 2 ARC Circuitry [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Deadline trader stock: From 3 to 1[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Power cell[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sell value: From 640 to 270 Coins[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Launcher ammo[/b][/p][list][*][p]Buy value:[/p][list][*][p]Old: 10 launcher ammo for 6,000 Coins[/p][/*][*][p]New: 6 launcher ammo for 4,500 Coins[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sell value: From 200 to 250[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting:[/p][list][*][p]Old: 6 launcher ammo for 4 Metal parts + 1 Explosive Compound[/p][/*][*][p]New: 6 launcher ammo for 1 ARC Motion Core + 2 Crude Explosives[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Launcher ammo crafting is available at the Workbench without needing a blueprint.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Venator[/b][/p][p][b]Dev note: [/b]The fully upgraded Venator has been over-performing recently, capable of outgunning full squads using close range weapons. We’re re-tuning the fire-rate gained from upgrades to pull down the pacing a bit, while still keeping its damage and accuracy intact. This should encourage players to take some more time with their shots rather than mag-dumping the first poor soul they encounter. The community also rightfully pointed out that the weight of the Venator was inconsistent with the weights of our other pistols, so we’ve corrected that as well.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced Fire-rate gained from upgrades from 22/44/60% to 13/26/40%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Weight from 2 to 5.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Explosive Damage[/b][/p][p][b]Dev note:[/b] We noticed that explosives dealt damage to more parts at once than intended, allowing weapons like the Hullcracker to kill larger drones too quickly. We’ve adjusted explosive damage to make it more consistent across the board, and we’ve re-balanced the damage of the Hullcracker to account for that change. This will require Hullcracker shots to need a bit more precision while still dealing good damage to the targeted spot.[/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced explosive damage against ARC for a more consistent experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosions on smaller enemies, e.g. Turrets are largely unaffected.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosions on larger sized enemies, e.g. Bastion will typically deal a bit less damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Content and Bug Fixes[/h2][h3]ARC[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where ARC could call down reinforcements outside the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Shredder[/p][list][*][p]Shredder will now detect and move more reliably towards Lure Grenades.[/p][/*][*][p]Shredder movement and handling updated: slightly reduced turn speed, improved braking, stiffer suspension, and more consistent reactions to impacts for steadier behavior in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Shredder navigation to prevent it from getting stuck on corners when moving toward the player.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Audio [/h3][list][*][p]Reduced volume attenuation for explosion tinnitus and concussion effects to improve clarity.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Maps [/h3][list][*][p]Barricades can no longer be placed overlapping your character, preventing clipping through walls and access to locked rooms.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Dam Battlegrounds[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players would get stuck in the Dam Control Tower elevator shaft.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Spaceport[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added collision to the staircase walls and ceiling in the Hidden Bunker on Spaceport.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could enter the wall near the Launch Tower ramp on Spaceport, preventing unfair ambushes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could access the locked room on the Control Tower without a key.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Blue Gate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed railing props on Blue Gate that mistakenly blocked bullets; shots now pass through as expected.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stella Montis[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a collision issue on Stella Montis near the Train Station that could cause players to fall through the terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a location in Stella Montis Train Station where players could get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed two player spawns on Stella Montis that were too close to ARC spawn areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing visibility collision on walls in the Business Center area of Stella Montis that allowed shots to pass through.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when using Raider Voice (proximity chat) on PCs without AVX2 support.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when surrendering after reconnecting to a session.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where scavenging parts from the Shredder could leave behind invisible collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Trials weekly rollover could display an outdated rank; the celebration now reflects the correct current rank and the UI remains accurate during the cooldown period.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated recommended AMD graphics driver to version 25.11.1 to reduce recent crash issues on AMD GPUs.[/p][/*][*][p]Your Raider Den has been ducked out.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Movement [/h3][list][*][p]Improved enemy ground detection to better handle steep surfaces, reducing erratic movement when traversing angled terrain.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons [/h3][list][*][p]Aphelion[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Aphelion tracers could become excessively bright at distance, reducing visibility for the player being shot at.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Aphelion blueprint drop rates.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Stitcher[/p][list][*][p]Corrected player facing stats for the Stitcher, showing incorrect scaling of reload time across upgrade levels.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/5af40b4d4bf6b35fa2fb168f01bfbd7847f2c067.jpg"][/img][/p][p]See you Topside,[/p][p]//Ossen
And the ARC Raiders Team[/p]

title: News from the Rust Belt!

contents: [p][b]From October 17th-19th, we’re running a three-day Server Slam Open Test.[/b] It’s one final opportunity to get your hands on ARC Raiders before launch. Get your Squad together and mark your calendars. The Rust Belt is calling! [/p][previewyoutube="XE0y_K8-iSQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p] We’ve decided to give you another scuffle on the surface and a chance to hop in and experience the game one more time before launch! Scavenge for loot, take a chance on an encounter with another Raider, and try to thin the ARC numbers a little. [/p][p]This event will bring you to the Dam Battlegrounds where you’ll experience elements of progression and crafting while completing a set of quests to provide you with a little taste of the ARC Raiders experience, while saving some surprises for the full launch. We’ll be stress-testing the servers during the event to get everything running smoothly before it all kicks off on October 30, so please invite your friends and give those servers a challenge! [/p][p][b]No codes this time. Everyone’s welcome.[/b] The Server Slam will be live on all platforms (Steam, Epic Games, PS5, Xbox X|S) and access will roll out slowly on day one. Progress made during the Slam will not carry over to the launch version of the game. Participating Raiders will, however, get a Server Slam Exclusive backpack to always signify that they were part of this historic moment, delivered to you after purchasing the full game at launch. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/a021d9e30ccf59d237c3a5893ee54e6cde471950.png"][/img][/p][p]Be on the lookout for more info as we get closer to October 17. Watch our socials and join the Official Discord for more information! Rally your crew, grab your gear, and get ready to go Topside and scavenge! [/p][p]If you’ve been in Speranza before, it’s time to return and bring your whole crew. If you’re a first-time Raider, an Embark ID will be created for you automatically when you launch ARC Raiders. You’ll also be prompted to enter and confirm your email address. While email confirmation isn’t required to play, you’ll need to confirm it in order to claim your exclusive Server Slam backpack reward at launch. You need to be 16+ to participate in Server Slam, terms apply.[/p][p]Want to get a head start? You can create a new Embark ID or link to an existing one ahead of time at the [u][url="https://id.embark.games/id/sign-in"]Embark Portal[/url][/u]. [/p][p]The world above is waiting, Raider. See you on the 17th. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Come and see us at TwitchCon San Diego! [/b][/h3][p]During the Server Slam, we’ll be pulling double duty at TwitchCon 2025 in San Diego.[/p][p]Take a break from shooting & looting in the Server Slam, and catch the team on the show floor at San Diego Convention Center, October 17-19! [/p][p]Play the game in the booth, pick up some swag (while supplies last), and meet some of the talented people behind ARC Raiders. We’ll also conduct a panel that you can attend in person or watch online! Whether you show up in the flesh or join us digitally, watch our socials for more details!  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Pre-Orders are Open! [/b][/h3][p]Saving the best for last, we’re opening up the Pre-orders [b]right now! [/b][/p][p]Secure your copy of the game as the Standard or Deluxe Edition! The Deluxe Edition comes with the Deluxe Pre-Order exclusive Astro Bundle*, the Scrappy Cowboy skin, 2400 Raider Tokens, and more to start your Raider off right!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624047/77c58cdb2f5f66ad82f2b2075ca2f4c0a78bf977.png"][/img][/p][p]Get your Standard Edition ($40USD) or the Deluxe Edition ($60USD) Pre-order copy now. You’ll be able to take the shuttle to the surface on October 30 on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S (The Standard Edition will be available for pre-order on Xbox soon). [/p][p]All pre-orders will receive the Lucky Duck Bundle, which contains the exclusive Hatchling Backpack and Golden Rubber Duck Backpack Charm![/p][p][b]Your story is about to begin, make it a good one.[/b][/p]

title: ARC Raiders releases October 30, 2025
author: rafael.campos
contents:
[p]Raiders,[/p][p]As you may have seen, we finally dropped the news many of you have been waiting for: [b]ARC Raiders launches on October 30, 2025, [/b]on PC through [i]Steam [/i]and the [i]Epic Games Store[/i], on consoles through [i]PlayStation 5[/i] and [i]Xbox Series X|S[/i], and via cloud streaming through [i]NVIDIA GeForce Now[/i]. [/p][p]The announcement was made on stage at the[i] Summer Game Fest[/i] show at the YouTube Theatre in Los Angeles just now, with a brand new trailer that you can check out here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sfufcWOh2LE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]From the very beginning, this project has been a labor of love, shaped not only by our team at Embark Studios, but by you, our community. Your feedback, energy, and support—particularly in the last two tech tests—have played a vital role in shaping the experience we’re about to launch. So on behalf of all of us, thank you![/p][p]Speaking of tech tests, a big shoutout to all of you who showed up and played last month! [/p][p]Tech Test 2 was the best rehearsal we could get ahead of release this fall. You gave us thoughtful, sharp feedback, and the test helped us hone in on plenty of things we’re addressing in the last stretch of development: there are bugs to squash, as well as general polish and performance improvements to be done. We're fine-tuning game balance and the player economy, and will work on an even better onboarding experience for players who come in new to this genre. [/p][p]At release, the game will also be expanded, with more locations to explore, more ARC enemies to fight, a larger selection of weapons and gear to find and craft, more adventures to embark on, and more for players to strive towards and discover. [/p][p]As we get closer to October, expect more details on what ARC Raiders will bring on launch day, and how we plan to grow, evolve, and support ARC Raiders after release. So mark your calendars, gear up, and rally your crew. Pre-orders will open later this summer. In the meantime, wishlist and follow us to stay updated. [/p][p][/p][p]See you topside in October![/p][p][/p][p]/[/p][p]Aleksander Grøndal
Executive Producer, ARC Raiders[/p][p]

title: Get Ready for the next ARC Raiders Tech Test 2
author: embark_cissi
contents:
[h2]Raiders![/h2]

On Wednesday, April 30th, we’re kicking off the ARC Raiders Tech Test 2, where invited playtesters on Steam, Epic Games Store, and consoles will be able to experience the deadly exploits of the Rust Belt, for five full days. 

This will be our largest test of ARC Raiders to date, for the first time also including players on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and the Epic Games Store. The purpose of the test is to see how the game performs in a live environment across all launch platforms and gather key insights and feedback from players like you.

This time around, you’re free to share or stream gameplay capture and tell the world of your experience in ARC Raiders — in other words, the playtest is [b]not confidential. [/b]

[url=https://id.embark.games/id/playtest-sign-in][b]Sign up now[/b][/url] for your chance to play ARC Raiders.

[previewyoutube=W-NUcKbwVb8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]So, what can I expect?[/b]

For those who may need a refresher: ARC Raiders is a multiplayer extraction adventure, set in a lethal future earth, where little remains of the world we know today.

On the surface, threats are everywhere: ARC machines loom high in the skies and lurk in the shadowy corners of abandoned spaceports and run-down warehouses. You’ll encounter everything from roaming rollbots to multi-legged behemoths, and the choice will be yours — team up to defeat them, or risk combat with your fellow Raiders if you'd rather keep the spoils for yourself.

While the line between friend and foe is razor thin on the surface, in Speranza, you’ll find refuge. The Traders there are ready to supply you with quests and gear. You can also craft equipment in your Raider Den, such as advanced weapon mods or unique gadgets. With every level gained on the surface, you can invest your experience into a branching skill tree.

[b]How do I get a chance to play?[/b]

To join the Tech Test 2, you must request access either on our sign up page on Embark ID (link) or on Steam. If you get access, you will be notified over e-mail. If you have previously played an ARC Raiders playtest on Steam, you will gain immediate access to this test too (but you won’t be notified). 

You must be at least 16 years of age to participate in Tech Test 2. The full Tech Test Terms of Service are available [url=https://www.embark-studios.com/tt2tos][b]here[/b][/url].

Access is given randomly, and we will distribute invites gradually throughout the test — so if you don’t get an invite on day one, you may get one later!

[b]Can I stream or share gameplay online?[/b]

Yes you can! Unlike previous playtests, this test is not confidential, and we encourage you to share your experience, record it, share with friends, or post on your favorite forum or social media site. Keep in mind though, that ARC Raiders remains in development and will see many tweaks, changes, and additions before launch.

[b]Anything else I should know?[/b]

[url=https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1TWJvjbJTsUrEfNHtIp1YOD7zRf4j9x_xvwASIymqAaE/edit?usp=sharing][b]Here’s a link to a document[/b][/url] we put together with some key details about ARC Raiders, the Tech Test 2, the experience of playing the game, an overview of some of the progression features, and more. You can also[url=http://discord.gg/arcraiders] [b]join our Discord[/b][/url] to get more information.

[i][b]See you in the Rust Belt, Raiders![/b][/i]
[i]/Aleksander Grøndal, Executive Producer ARC Raiders[/i]

title: ARC Raiders | Gameplay Reveal

contents:
[h3][b]ARC Raiders Gameplay Reveal[/b][/h3]

Raiders!

We’re still busy reviewing all the feedback from last month's tech test. Again, thanks so much for taking the time to play with us! Early software and all, this was a really encouraging playtest. Lots of great feedback and many of you seem to appreciate the atmosphere of the world we've created and the immersion we’re bringing to the table with ARC Raiders. 

There's also a lot we can do to continue optimizing and balancing the experience. As we keep developing the game, we're keen to deliver on a much expanded late-game experience, with deeper progression and extensive quests that take players across new locations — as well as a larger variety of ARC machines and other world-encounters, and some other improvements and surprises (!).

To those of you who didn’t get access this time around, stay tuned. We’re aiming to host more playtests across all platforms before release. We also know many of you are eager to see the game, so we decided to put together a longer gameplay reveal and walkthrough!

In this gameplay reveal, which was captured on the tech test build, we follow a squad of three Raiders as they venture above ground on a quest to extract valuable items within the Buried City of Southern Calabretta; attempting to avoid ARC and cautiously discovering if other Raiders are friends or foes. The footage also provides a glimpse of Speranza, the place Raiders call home and where every Raider's adventure begins — and hopefully ends.

author: Embark | Oscar
contents:
Raiders!

On Thursday, October 24, we’re kicking off the [b]ARC Raiders Tech Test[/b], where invited Steam playtesters will be able to experience the Rust Belt and some of what it has to offer, for four full days. 

[previewyoutube=X9l7XMmX0bo;full][/previewyoutube]

The purpose of this test is to assess how the game plays in a live setting, get feedback, and evaluate the experience across several areas. It’s an important moment for us to get valuable input from players outside the studio, that will help inform our priorities and focus as we head into the last stretch of development before the game’s full release in 2025. This won’t be the last public test before release. 

Now let’s go over some housekeeping!

[b]How do I get a chance to play?[/b]

First, make sure you’re signed up for Playtesting on our Steam app, and check your email to see if you have an invite! You need to be at least 16 years of age to participate in the test.

While this is the largest external playtest of ARC Raiders to date, we will need to cap the maximum amount of players. Access is given randomly, and we will distribute invites gradually throughout the test — so if you don’t get an invite on day one, you may get one later!

Invited participants will also be able to invite two friends after completing four rounds, so if you have a pal with access, check with them! 

[b]Can I stream or share gameplay online?[/b]

Short answer: no. 

This test is not intended as a public marketing beat for the game. We want to introduce ARC Raiders to the world when the game is polished and ready and we need your help to keep the mystery and excitement alive while we finish the game. This is why tech test participants are subject to non-disclosure obligations, to preserve the experience for everyone.

This means that testers are not allowed to talk about the playtest or share images, videos, or streams of gameplay.

[b]What are the minimum / recommended PC specs?[/b]

Minimum 
OS: Windows 10 64-bit (latest update) 
CPU: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor 
RAM: 12GB RAM 
Video: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 580 

Recommended 
OS: Windows 10 64-bit (latest update) 
CPU: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor 
RAM: 16GB RAM 
Video: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

[b]Anything else I should know?[/b]

Here’s [url=https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/17qidm7QqTSArPuZFMjzWI3to_QrgD2bKtiX1k5TjkGc/edit?usp=sharing]a link to a document[/url] we put together with some key details about ARC Raiders, the Tech Test, the experience of playing the game, an overview of some of the progression features, and more. You can also head over to [url=https://discord.com/invite/arcraiders]our Discord[/url] for more info, troubleshooting, and bug reporting.

See you in the Rust Belt,

/Aleksander Grøndal, Executive Producer on ARC Raiders

title: ARC Raiders is Coming in 2025 — PC Playtesting Starts This Fall
author: rafael.campos
contents:
Raiders!

I’m Aleksander Gröndal, the executive producer on ARC Raiders! 

In case you missed it, we just announced some news about ARC Raiders at the Gamescom Opening Night Live show in Cologne (where I’m at right now). 

Let’s get into it. 

First things first, ARC Raiders will launch in 2025 here on Steam, as well as on the Epic Game Store, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and on cloud streaming via Nvidia GeForce Now. 

There will be opportunities for you to experience the game earlier than that. In around two months from now, between October 24 and October 27, we’re planning a first public Tech Test here on Steam. For an opportunity to play, make sure to sign up for Playtesting on our Steam store page. For this test, we will select participants randomly from our pool of playtesters. 

We’re also making an important change to our business model. 

You may recall that ARC Raiders was announced as a free-to-play game. Today, we announced that ARC Raiders will be released as a $40 premium title. There are many reasons for this change, and they all boil down to our conviction that a premium business model is a better fit for the type of game we’re building. A premium model allows us to create a more focused, balanced, and engaging action-survival experience. 

We also released a teaser, that you can watch here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z8NN00Wtj5c

I know it’s been some time since we talked about ARC Raiders, so here’s a refresher:
In ARC Raiders you enter a vast and lethal world.

People have fled to the underground colony of Speranza, seeking supplies to survive, and shelter from ARC machines on the surface. Demand for resources is at an all-time high, but venturing the surface to get them is a risky job. 

You’re a newly enlisted as a Raider, fighting for your own survival and that of your neighborhood in the underground colony — scavenging and hunting for resources that must be extracted back safely from the surface.  Standing in your way are ARC machines — a mysterious, deadly foe — as well as other players — Raiders — who are also competing for loot and their own survival. 

To grow as a Raider, you must make it back down to the colony alive. There, you get to meet the traders of Speranza to trade your loot and valuables, embark on quests, upgrade and improve and expand your chambers, and grow your character to suit your playstyle — to become the Raider that you want to be.

Whether teaming up or going solo, it’s a game that rewards thinking ahead and carefully observing the world around you, rather than running into action guns blazing. The gameplay is tactile, visceral, and grounded, with a rich and playful sandbox of gadgets and tools, beyond just guns and ammo.
 
While ARC Raiders has changed and evolved over the course of development, the world we have built has always been our anchor. To cite Stefan Strandberg, our creative director, we’re drawing inspiration from current-day themes taken to their extreme — like the prospect of colonizing space, at a time when the relationship between man and machine is becoming increasingly fraught. 

It’s a game that takes place in a post-post apocalypse — a distant future where humanity has moved on to build anew.  Surely, this world can be a dangerous and treacherous place — but at the same time, it’s inherently hopeful, vibrant, and charming.  

With the first Tech Test coming up in October, you should stay tuned for the latest updates and information on ARC Raiders here on Steam, via Embark’s Discord, arcraiders.com, Twitter / X, and YouTube. 

With that, I hope to see you in the Rust Belt.

title: What’s next for ARC Raiders
author: rafael.campos
contents:
I am Aleks and I am the executive Producer for ARC Raiders here at Embark Studios. 

If you venture over to the Steam page for ARC Raiders, you might notice some changes in the way we describe the game. 

These changes are fundamental enough that we think it’s important to provide some context and describe in some more detail what kind of game ARC Raiders is. 

Last spring, we made the decision to move the release of ARC Raiders in order to focus on releasing THE FINALS, our team-based first-person shooter, as our first game. At that time, we also said we were giving the ARC Raiders team time to add PvP to the existing foundation of the game.

Since then, over the course of development, ARC Raiders has taken the shape of what we believe to be a truly promising PvPvE survival extraction shooter — a game that stays true to the ARC Raiders universe and we’re having a blast testing internally. 

ARC Raiders drops players into a lethal but stunningly beautiful future earth, with hair-raising moments of survival and suspense. Human versus machine, human versus human, together or alone, and you versus the sometimes conflicting nature of your own humanity, all in the spectacular backdrop of a landscape littered with the haunting remains of the past. 

Here is an excerpt to help paint a picture of what you can expect at this time in our development of the game: 

----

[i]People have fled to the underground colony of Speranza, seeking supplies to survive, and shelter from the machines. Demand for resources is at an all-time high. But getting those resources is a risky job, and it isn’t for everyone.

But it is a job for you. 

That’s why you’ve enlisted as a Raider, scavenging for vital supplies that are scattered across the 5landscape. Everything from leftovers from yesterday’s run-in with ARC to the unlikely remains of a pinball machine.

Out there, the stakes are high, and you will have to fight for your loot. Lethal ARC machines roam the surface. And there are no rules in Calabretta, so beware of other Raiders. 

With the traders in Speranza, trust is hard-earned and easily lost. You need to earn your keep. So don't come back from a quest empty-handed. 

When you see another Raider chased by a swarm of ARC drones, do you go in for the kill? Do you lend a helping hand? Or do you hold back and feast on the valuable remains?
[/i]

----

The next step for us is a Closed Alpha test to and get feedback on the game’s core systems and loops. This will be the first road test of ARC Raiders and an important step for the game, which so far has never been in the hands of external players. 

This test will be closed and under NDA, because work remains on the game and we’re not quite ready to reveal everything about it. We have some big theories to prove before it’s time to put them on the world’s stage. 

If you would like to give it a try and help us illuminate the path, we’d love for you to head on over and sign up for the opportunity to playtest this summer. 


[h3]Sign up for the playtest Now![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808500/ARC_Raiders/

title: ARC Raiders | Reveal Trailer

contents:
Raiders,

ARC is on screen. Calling for volunteers.

Enlist. Resist.

[previewyoutube=3BKASgkxK1g;full][/previewyoutube]

A patchwork early warning system has alerted you and your squad of Raiders, a rogue group of resistance fighters, that enemies are dropping from orbit. It is time to defend our home. 

The ruthless, mechanized threat descending from space is known as ARC, and while the odds are stacked against you, unpredictability and diversity are the Raiders’ strengths. Do the unexpected using physics, your surroundings, and your wits in combat that demands more than simply matching ammo to a weapon. 

Lone wolves never make it very far when ARC is around, so you will need to fight, flee, and fine-tune, shoulder to shoulder with your squad.

As a Raider, your approach is scrappy, but it's never half-hearted, and while you should come prepared, remember that sometimes you just have to wing it.
